The Arizona Supreme Court just issued a decision that a near-total abortion ban from 1864 — decades before women could vote & decades before Arizona was even a state — can take effect in the state. Remember: this is brought to you by Trump. He knew that overturning Roe v. Wade would pave the way for cruel bans like these. And Trump is proudly taking credit for that. We can stop these abortion bans by keeping the White House, winning back the House, expanding our Senate majority, and ending the filibuster to pass national, federal protections. This is in reach, and we’ve got to fight hard this year for it. **But until then, we’ve got to support patients in need of care and organizations on the front lines of this fight.[So can you make a $28 donation to support the Abortion Fund of Arizona right now? This organization is working to get abortion patients in the state access to the care they need. 100% of your donation will support this fund.](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2031?amount=28&t=8&akid=2010%2E4032634%2EVqNUqn)**

subject: my friend, Harry
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Harry Dunn for Congress
body:
Harry will make an amazing Congressman |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82799144/466336987/-742709655?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2024.04.10_B1_Colin-Allred_U1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzODYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjVkYTQ2MDktOWNmNy1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=W1uZWvUnTP-Xt0qL9ZgL--IXWyV9sSShuDbWeHVD3pw=)
---
Hey there, it's Colin Allred, *the* Texas Democrat running to unseat extremist Ted Cruz in the Senate.

I've served in Congress for the past 5 years, and no day is more vivid in my memory than January 6, 2021.

That day I walked into Congress ready to certify the results of the 2020 Presidential Election, but instead, I was trapped in the House Chamber, preparing to defend myself and my colleagues against a violent mob storming the Capitol.

As they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife, Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second child, "Whatever happens, I love you." Then I took off my jacket and got ready to fight off anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, because of the bravery of officers like Harry, the worst didn't happen and I got to meet my son Cameron. Congress owes a large debt of gratitude to law enforcement officers for protecting every single one of us, regardless of our politics.

**That's why I know Harry will make an amazing Congressman for Maryland.**

He'll protect reproductive rights, Social Security and voting rights, the same way he protected our democracy with his bare hands.

I'm beyond grateful to have won my primary election last month. And I was able to do it because of grassroots support from folks just chipping in $10 or $25 at a time.

clean_body: Harry will make an amazing Congressman | = Hey there, it's Colin Allred, the Texas Democrat running to unseat extremist Ted Cruz in the Senate. I've served in Congress for the past 5 years, and no day is more vivid in my memory than January 6, 2021. That day I walked into Congress ready to certify the results of the 2020 Presidential Election, but instead, I was trapped in the House Chamber, preparing to defend myself and my colleagues against a violent mob storming the Capitol. As they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife, Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second child, "Whatever happens, I love you." Then I took off my jacket and got ready to fight off anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, because of the bravery of officers like Harry, the worst didn't happen and I got to meet my son Cameron. Congress owes a large debt of gratitude to law enforcement officers for protecting every single one of us, regardless of our politics. That's why I know Harry will make an amazing Congressman for Maryland. He'll protect reproductive rights, Social Security and voting rights, the same way he protected our democracy with his bare hands. I'm beyond grateful to have won my primary election last month. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: on the road again . . .
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Last week, the Florida Supreme Court made a HUGE decision!

They upheld the state’s previous _15 Week Abortion Prevention Act,_ **meaning the _Students for Life Action_ -inspired _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Law_ went into effect!**

This law will save tens of thousands of lives from abortion every year . . . that is, if it STAYS in effect.

You see, the Florida Supreme Court also ruled that a radical pro-abortion Ballot Initiative, vaguely allowing abortion “before viability,” could be added to the ballot this November.

This would effectively WIPE the _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Law_ off the books!

That’s why _Students for Life Action_ is ramping up our efforts heavily in the Sunshine State: if the pro-abortion Ballot Initiative passes, Florida will become THE abortion destination of the American Southeast and even for Central and South American countries!

You and I can’t let Florida turn into an “abortion tourism” destination.

Not only is this ballot battle of huge consequence, but Florida is also a critical swing state in the 2024 elections.

With your prayers and support, _Students for Life Action_ is preparing to send our very own **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** to Florida for our _“No on 4 Tour”_ to fight against this deadly Ballot Initiative and call attention to our Election Year Programs.

The good news is, thanks to the generous financial support from pro-lifers like you, _Students for Life Action_ already owns the truck, video displays, and all the equipment.

But as you’ll see below, even though we already made the investment in this truck, there are still many costs associated with bringing our pro-life message to key districts across Florida with the truck.

**[So, I must ask, will you please prayerfully consider making a contribution to sponsor our Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck as it makes its way through the Sunshine State](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sudtjiy-duchtdja-y/)?**

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sudtjiy-duchtdja-j/)
With your support, this massive mobile electronic billboard will expose the records of pro-abortion politicians to voters in their districts AND call out abortion extremism wherever we see it.

No doubt the Abortion Lobby will be FURIOUS that they won’t be able to shut us up.

With our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck,** _Students for Life Action_ is able to:

**>>>** Launch massive statewide tours reaching tens of thousands more voters than a standing billboard ever could by taking the message TO THEM;
**>>>** Change messages quickly and easily when needed – which you can’t do with static billboards. If a pro-abortion Senator sticks a foot in his mouth a week before Election Day, we’ll be able to go to their district and expose them to their voters;
**>>>** Screen pro-life movies like _Unplanned_ on college campuses, which is PROVEN to convert even the most hardcore pro-abortion radicals;
**>>>** Compliment our door-knocking campaigns in key communities and even on college campuses; and
**>>>** “Crash” high-profile events like Presidential debates or pro-abortion marches while we play video messages of all of the insane things pro-abortion radicals say that media elites ignore.
**[That's why I hope you will help me send a message that pro-abortion politicians and their pals can't ignore by making a generous contribution to _Students for Life Action's_ Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck efforts as it’s on the road in Florida](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sudtjiy-duchtdja-i/)!**

You see, _if the funds we raise allow it,_ our goal is to take this truck **_NATIONWIDE_** later this summer as election season continues to heat up.

We’ll be tailoring specific messaging in each state we come across.

For example, here are a few of the states we’re targeting:

**● _Oklahoma_** – where we will highlight our efforts to fight dangerous Chemical Abortion Pills, specifically through our _Clean Water for All Life Act_ and our _Anti-Pill Trafficking Bill;_
**● _South Carolina_** – where we will highlight the SIX Republican senators who betrayed their constituents and joined Democrats to block the state’s _Human Life Protection Act_ from passing; and
**● _Nebraska_** – where Republican Senator Merv Riepe single handedly blocked a _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Act_ from passing.
As you can imagine, the fuel for an F-250 is not cheap – _especially when you’re driving it around for months at a time_ – not to mention the cost for drivers, food stipends, and lodging.

But considering how many voters we’re going to reach between now and November, I believe our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** will be a massive bang-for-your-buck. We know from past truck deployments, in fact.

**[So, will you please consider making your most generous contribution possible to _Students for Life Action_ to help us come up with the funds we need to get this Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck to these crucial states](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sudtjiy-duchtdja-d/)?**

After factoring everything in, it will cost us about $1.50 per mile.

**[A $750 gift will sponsor 500 miles for our Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sudtjiy-duchtdja-h/).**
**[A $375 gift will sponsor 250 miles](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sudtjiy-duchtdja-k/).**
**[A $150 gift will sponsor 100 miles](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sudtjiy-duchtdja-u/).**
**[A $75 gift will sponsor 50 miles](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sudtjiy-duchtdja-o/).**
**[A $30 gift will sponsor 20 miles](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sudtjiy-duchtdja-b/).**

Of course, any amount you can give will make a great impact!

Thank you for all you do for Life. I’ll be sure to keep you updated on all of our 2024 Election Year efforts.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. I'm coming to you personally to ask for your help because I see a lot of parallels between Debbie's story and mine. She is, without a doubt, the kind of leader Floridians deserve in a Senator.

Debbie grew up in a one room apartment, and her mother — an immigrant from Ecuador — worked tirelessly to provide a better life for Debbie and her sisters, so they could achieve their American dream. I grew up with six brothers and sisters in a two room house in Jacksonville. My mom worked as a maid, and my dad was a janitor. We both know what it means to work hard and persevere.

Debbie and I also grew up working minimum wage jobs, and yet we went on to serve in Congress together. We've dedicated our careers to public service because we want every Floridian to have the opportunities we had — to ensure the American dream is within reach for _each and every one of them._
But do you know who is standing in the way of the American dream for far too many Floridians? Our extremist Senator, Rick Scott, who is beholden to a disgraced, twice-impeached former president, Donald Trump.

A mere 35% of Floridians view Rick Scott favorably, friend. It's no wonder why. **But Scott spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this Senate seat in 2018, and he's already spent millions this time around in his efforts to repeat history.**

Experts everywhere are saying this will be one of the most competitive — _and expensive_ — races in the country. I know that Debbie can defeat Rick Scott and deliver the leadership Florida deserves, but only with the power of a grassroots movement fueled by people like you, friend. **[Please rush an urgent donation to help Debbie hit her $300,000 weekly fundraising goal, defeat Rick Scott, and protect our Democratic Senate majority!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82799540/466351740/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1067-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODYxMTY5ZWMtYTBmNy1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VXFf4slGK_l7_CcY9StqvBCNVjsXWNx2sK60MyiIw6s=)**

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: a dark day
disclaimer_text: paid for and provided in kind by End Citizens United Nonfederal, P
body:
Yesterday, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=21224%2E4449941%2EO_uhLI)
---
Team, I am incredibly disappointed.

Yesterday, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.

No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.

As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.

It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.

It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.

If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster.

I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

Peter -- With our weekly fundraising deadline coming up, we want you to remember something. _Really remember._ Remember how you felt the day Donald Trump was sworn into office. Remember listening to him speak of American carnage and being afraid of what was to come. And remember time and time again how those fears were realized over the next four years. Now remember how you felt after Joe Biden was sworn in. Remember that relief you felt that we didn’t have to deal with Trump in office any longer, and the hope you felt that we could get America back on track. **We can’t go back.** We can’t go back to the way we all felt when Trump was elected. Peter, it might be wild to think, but you have a central role in making sure we win. The work we need to do is only possible because of people like you making the decision that we can’t go back..._we can only go forward._ Now, we don’t expect you to donate every day, _but with President Biden facing millions of dollars in attack ads, he needs you to make today the day._ So, please: **Millions of supporters from across the country have stepped up to support President Biden, and he has told us how grateful he is for that.** [**Can he count on you to contribute $5, $10, or whatever you can afford today? subject: Stay tuned / Manténganse al tanto
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Black Mamas Matter: TOP Commemorates 2024 Black Maternal Health Week
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%202023%20Black%20Maternal%20Health%20Week.png]
At TOP, we believe healthcare is a right. We are committed to advocating for policies that promote equity across the entire healthcare system.
As we prepare to commemorate Black Maternal Health Week [https://blackmamasmatter.org/bmhw-2024/] starting April 11th through the 17th , it's essential to bring attention to the persistent and alarming disparities in maternal health outcomes affecting Black women in Texas [https://www.texastribune.org/2023/08/29/texas-maternal-mortality-black-women/] . With a maternal mortality rate more than twice as high as that of white women in our state, it’s clear the current healthcare system is failing Black mothers and their families.
There is nowhere in the country where Black women’s maternal mortality is more acute than Texas.
RSVP: San Antonio "Know Your Rights" event on SB4 on April 27
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SB4%20SA%20training.jpg]
SB4 [https://www.keranews.org/texas-news/2024-04-02/texas-immigration-enforcement-bill-sb4-is-back-in-federal-appeals-court-wednesday] is a racist law that is wholly rooted in white supremacy. This anti-immigrant law will effectively give license to local law enforcement to criminalize and incarcerate Black and Latino immigrants.
It’s more important now than ever to ensure that we are all properly equipped with the necessary knowledge to protect ourselves against dangerous legislation. TOP will be hosting a “Know Your Rights” training in San Antonio at the Westfall Branch Library on April 27 from 12:30 - 2:30 p.m.
Click here to RSVP and for more information! [https://secure.everyaction.com/T-9x9P2RKE2ScFBfgD7dkQ2]
Help Shape the Future of Harris County
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Rodney%20Ellis%20survey.png]
Commissioner Rodney Ellis wants to hear from YOU, Harris County!
Harris County has embarked on a strategic planning process to help guide our work. This is the time to make sure they hear from YOU on the issues that matter most to you. This is an opportunity to share OUR priorities as we think about where we are headed.
If you’re a Harris County resident, please take a few minutes to complete the survey for us to help build a better county together. [https://survey.alchemer.com/s3/7792896/Precinct-One-Community-Strategic-Planning]
TOP Tip: Get those taxes done
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/File%20taxes%202023.jpeg]
The clock is ticking! The April 15th tax filing deadline is almost here. Don’t wait until the last minute. File your taxes now and check this important task off the list. Click here for some last minute tips. [https://www.consumeraffairs.com/news/here-are-some-last-minute-tax-filing-tips-040924.html]
Español
La madres Negras importan: TOP conmemora la Semana de la Salud Materna Negra de 2024
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Spanish%20Black%20Maternal%20Health%20Week.jpg]
En TOP creemos que la atención sanitaria es un derecho. Estamos comprometidos a abogar por políticas que promuevan la equidad en todo el sistema de salud.
Mientras nos preparamos para conmemorar la Semana de la Salud Materna de las Personas Negras [https://blackmamasmatter.org/bmhw-2024/] , que comienza del 11 al 17 de abril , es esencial llamar la atención sobre las persistentes y alarmantes disparidades en los resultados de la salud materna que afectan a las mujeres Negras en Texas [https://www.texastribune.org/2023/08/29/texas-maternal-mortality-black-women/] . Con una tasa de mortalidad materna más del doble que la de las mujeres blancas en nuestro estado, está claro que el sistema de salud actual les está fallando a las madres negras y sus familias.
No hay ningún lugar del país donde la mortalidad materna de las mujeres negras sea más crítica que Texas.
Confirme su asistencia: Evento "Conozca sus derechos" en San Antonio sobre SB4 el 27 de abril
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SB4%20SA%20training.jpg]
La SB4 [https://www.keranews.org/texas-news/2024-04-02/texas-immigration-enforcement-bill-sb4-is-back-in-federal-appeals-court-wednesday] es una ley racista que se basa totalmente en la supremacía blanca. Esta ley antiinmigrante facilitará que las autoridades locales criminalicen y encarcelen a inmigrantes Negros y Latinos.
Es importante que todos estemos equipados con el conocimiento que necesitamos para protegernos contra esta peligrosa ley. TOP organizará una capacitación “Conozca sus derechos” en San Antonio en la biblioteca Westfall Branch el 27 de abril de 12:30 a 2:30 p.m.
¡Haga clic aquí para confirmar su asistencia y obtener más información! [https://secure.everyaction.com/T-9x9P2RKE2ScFBfgD7dkQ2]
Ayude a determinar el futuro del Condado de Harris
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Rodney%20Ellis%20survey.png]
El comisionado Rodney Ellis quiere saber de USTED, Condado de Harris!
El condado de Harris se ha embarcado en un proceso de planificación estratégica para ayudar a guiar nuestro trabajo. Este es el momento de asegurarse de que escuchen de USTED sobre los temas que más le importan. Esta es una oportunidad para compartir NUESTRAS prioridades mientras pensamos hacia dónde nos dirigimos.
Si es residente del condado de Harris, tómese unos minutos para completar la encuesta y ayudarnos a construir juntos un mejor condado. [https://survey.alchemer.com/s3/7792896/Precinct-One-Community-Strategic-Planning]
Consejos de TOP: Presenta tus impuestos pronto
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/File%20taxes%202023.jpeg]
¡El reloj está corriendo! La fecha límite para la presentación de impuestos del 15 de abril ya casi está aquí. No esperes hasta el último minuto. Presente sus impuestos ahora y tache esta importante tarea de la lista. Haga clic aquí para obtener algunos consejos de última hora. [https://www.consumeraffairs.com/news/here-are-some-last-minute-tax-filing-tips-040924.html]

name: Joe Cohn
subject: A New Perspective
body:
Peter, I'm running for Congress
Peter --You might have heard the exciting news--I recently threw my hat in the ring as a Democrat for the Third Congressional District of New Jersey. Now, I know what you might be thinking--why Congress? Well, here's why: **I believe our district deserves someone with a new perspective who's all about making a real difference in people's lives, not just playing political games. **Throughout my career, I've been all about fighting for what's right. >From helping folks with HIV/AIDS keep stable housing to standing up against discrimination in the workplace, I've been in the trenches, fighting for justice. I've defended the rights of environmentalists, Occupy activists, LGBTQ students, and prisoners who were gassed in their cells. And I've been a fierce advocate for free speech rights across the political spectrum.

**[But now, I'm ready to take things to the next level and fight for our community in Congress.](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail19.com/t/d-l-eyuihld-djqxtuyu-r/)** I won't sugarcoat it--stepping into the political arena is no easy feat. But when I look at what's going on in our country--the chaos in Washington, attacks on our democracy, you name it--I know I have to do everything I can to help turn this around. We've got some serious work to do, and I'm ready to roll up my sleeves and get to it.**So, what am I all about?** Well, for starters, I'm all about defending civil liberties for everyone, protecting our democracy, and making sure our families have the support they need to thrive.**And unlike some others,_I'm not afraid to stand up to the extremists out there, while also reaching across the aisle to find common ground with folks who may not see eye to eye with me._** I'm fired up about the opportunity to represent our district in Congress, and I'd love to have your support along the way.[Check out my website at joecohnforcongress.com to learn more about me and my campaign.](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail19.com/t/d-l-eyuihld-djqxtuyu-y/)Sincerely, [](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail19.com/t/d-l-eyuihld-djqxtuyu-j/) [ Share ](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail19.com/t/d-fb-eyuihld-djqxtuyu-t/) [ Tweet ](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail19.com/t/d-tw-eyuihld-djqxtuyu-i/) [ Share ](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail19.com/t/d-li-eyuihld-djqxtuyu-o/) [ Forward ](https://joecohnforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/d-djqxtuyu-CD27C743-eyuihld-l-b) | Joe Cohn for Congress If you wish to unsubscribe click the link below: [Unsubscribe](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail19.com/t/d-u-eyuihld-djqxtuyu-n/)

## Inflation Rises 3.5%, Hotter Than Expected
Consumer prices rose 3.5% in March, higher than expected, signaling that [inflation has accelerated](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL9utDAQxJ_GdIvsxXBcQfE1dPe1KZFt1sdG_oOMc-jePiJKmWaaGf1mNB-P5WE4cHr-N5Gm6vNiXOUXLRqUAtSLbtbJEyF1DU3qpnDUOKBqtklakp3rR-rs3ZHtpR28t3awZu1utFLDE0rUUisl7_2gxxa9X40eSCKukswotKSVay7tZ-ZUN_LhnV9UWpdjE6at1v0Q3T-Bs8D5PM_WJesuU-B8oQXO8hIlBc5uZ-Dkg6mcE0RT3AZXCFxOx1ekAnthRweUfBB0-9XY71QcpQq-5AgG3mQKmGcG_iW0W42hKdO6nxwCH8NNaPmMhsPPxvrnY98BAAD__y9pbdY) over the last 12 months. The news casts doubt about the timing of any future interest-rate cuts. Inflation was driven up by the cost of energy and shelter, [which alone rose 5.7%](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ_G7ohgvcG4oPiadPnaKy1-lmRPGCyMHOXtT7n6ytE0o_m6r3fHmcvjv9vI9lRXFzqftKJQSgCuOEabiICmkayaFRgEDWp82jhHSIg6GvI4YVLGeT05CIvEcPVmZAsSUKJScrlqNBdIKTrUJAGiJGcGlBS513b5rlz6k1J-15PaJdRtzPbZ-34M078BbgPc3F7odXzUB1rnkGmAG5eUXedaxN440CGa63QICrXU7S0SRWoui0YHtZOE50hFJAl-0UtUHtHNIXg5masnOaVZ60hybDbuL86ZDz0PKB-b4_xb1f989BMAAP__Z9Nokg) from a year ago. Prices for gas, clothing, car repairs, and groceries also helped push inflation higher in March. With the economy as [a top election issue](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ_GdEb23v7AFRR_Q3dpUyJjr4-NjI3M5kjePiJ1mplipNGn7_0xPxwnzs83t9EosczOC79oRm2tBpyxCWMkAro1NNrewoDQgW3WkTy4m0EcCAegxdwhDr5fegj93YIzDY9gAA1aa-7_OhxaiDE47MgABENuUGgosJTafhTOslJM3-VFtfVla9K4iuyHuv1XMCmYzvNsfV78NSqYrmsFk7nCGgWT1M9t10dy26EXDpR1LFVzjskJl6xdFKp6LXKVrC5r-trJCwXtd9aV9lKlXWVLTR3DfnJKfHS9QvPcHKdfJvnT0E8AAAD__3RJZ9Y), President Biden and former President Trump issued warring statements. Biden blamed Republicans and corporate greed for inflation, while Trump argued Biden's economic policies caused it. The Dow finished [over 400 points lower](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GOqzAQRb_GdCB7MhincPEaurx2SzSxx8EbE0cwC8rfr5J6m9tc6Rydr8t0oVzy4_afFvaS6kRB8s4Ttsa0gBM20Sdm4FPD3gwGHIIF08xeG4OWWSd3dZYcDQmH_gTcWwo99tBkDxpQozH63Ft0HaQUCS1rgKiZnELNMUtdu--aHzJzKq-689qFujTFzyLPTZ3-KRgVjMdxdOFxDe9TwfhGKxj1Z84Kxk1quLcLrXeWVmqkV1vyzu3PM5Lw1s2ylGb18XnkUvJmB4X6tlAuH5v82f4bAAD__54DWTM) Wednesday as investors weighed the report's impact on potential interest rate cuts.
## GOP Group Revolts on Surveillance Bill
Conservative Republicans joined Democrats to block an effort Wednesday [to reauthorize a national security surveillance program](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3ojgfMb2wNAlW7p2tC5wxKQYLCCJ-vdVOnd8esvT-7qsFwoxpNsn7WyazyvZFp68olBKAK7YO-OZgYeejZoUzAgaVL8Zr8frNFqQREo5VANZzZKvI7kr4yL7YEACSlRKLqPG-QTeO0LNEsBJprlDyS60XE73HFLb2Mef_ORysnnvo9laO2o3fHRw7uBMR-JXfas3lBZs5A7OPlQSLieKTrTy2A9RH-XJIUZKloXN6Va4VrGHbxb3vKWak9AwOI-IoCeeYLQ086AGWEY5gpcL98W44xViDFVPHcrbTiH-VbV_H_0GAAD__3k1aB8) backed by House Speaker Mike Johnson. The law will expire next week unless renewed. The Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act, or FISA, allows the U.S. to collect data on non-Americans outside the country without a warrant. The reauthorization adds reforms to satisfy critics who complain the surveillance law could violate Americans' rights. Johnson made a strong push for passage of the reforms, and the defeat was seen as against him. He vowed to regroup and continue fighting for passage before the FISA law expires. Olympics Track and Field Winners to Get $50,000 Track and field's governing body will pay its Olympic athletes they win at this summer's Games in Paris, the first time a sports federation has paid prize money for victories. The cash awards are available only for track and field events as part of a $2.4 million program set up by World Athletics, the sport's governing body. The group's president said it's to recognize the athletes that bring in the federation's revenue. The U.S. and a few other countries give bonuses for gold medals, but no other sports federations offer prize money. The move has been hailed in the move toward paying amateur athletes. A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

body:
Our nation and the world face many problems today, some of which may seem overwhelming, but there are still reasons for hope.
| | | |
---
Many Reasons for Hope
# By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Hello Peter,
Our nation and the world face many problems today, some of which may seem overwhelming, but there are still reasons for hope.
I'm running for Congress because I don't like the direction our country is headed. Open borders, crime, inflation, drugs, violent assaults, failing schools, contention in the capitol, and a myriad of other problems have most Americans saying we are headed in the wrong direction. It can all sound quite bleak, but change starts with hope - the hope that you and I can still make a difference.
Anne Frank wrote in her diary, "How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world." During a NATO assignment to Europe, I visited the home where Anne Frank wrote these words. Talk about bleak; Anne and her family had lost everything and were hiding from evil Nazis who wanted to capture and kill them. Yet, she was able to find reasons for hope.
You and I have many more reasons to have hope. Despite our problems, we still live in the greatest country on earth. Prophets foretold of this "promised land" of freedom and opportunity. You and I have the privilege of deciding if we will "improve the world." It is as simple as being kind to someone, starting with our family, neighbors, and community.
This is why I chose to run for the House of Representatives. According to our constitution, the President represents the entire country; senators represent their respective States. The members of the House of Representatives represent the people. As a Congressman, I can improve the world one person at a time.
As one of 435 voices in Congress, I will fight to fix our country. I will not be able to solve all our nation's problems alone, but I can improve the lives of the people I represent in Boulder City, Henderson, and the east side of Las Vegas.
If someone's Social Security check is missing - I'll represent them. If someone is having difficulty getting their Veteran benefits - I'll represent them. It will be my job to make sure the Federal government is working for the 750,000 people within Nevada's First Congressional District.
To do this, I will be home in Henderson every weekend and whenever Congress is not in session. I will have a robust staff of caring people who live and work here in Southern Nevada. I will be loyal to the Constitution and the people of my District.
Please join me in this mission. As Ronald Reagan said, "You and I have a rendezvous with destiny. We will preserve for our children this, the last best hope of man on earth..."
Together, we will take back our country!
Mark Robertson

*************************************************************************************************

1. Tell others about Mark. This can be done face-to-face, over the phone, via email or text, on social media, or any other method. Encourage people to vote for Mark early, in person or by mail.

body:
President Biden’s proposed $7.3 trillion federal budget spends wildly in almost every area, but then skimps on the most important priority of all—our national defense.
| | |
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001j6FoiwNQ7V4dm1st1eWYCOAbc8OFvdu3jQ6UzYLeJo-6bpxteHhR2y27OJa4L2EwKdP0pgaYaYwv3352uAd-s_7IlGSFsb9qSOd67Xs3PG-t2oCxuwDLKacgB19UWm_gL8vDoATiA3yln7m9KMZvvEfbybMlIk_o&c=nqNFIBQN4MfCmDdw77SPtQHr5uyZv5IvUdQaopoFEPO7E2Z0t7s0aQ==&ch=fhkex0SaE_VVgW3vHxdZV_a9MhqjfPG6Ycn9uFo1-43FhPchcOWP7w==)
---
|
Friend
President Biden's proposed $7.3 trillion federal budget spends wildly in almost every area, but then skimps on the most important priority of all--our national defense. This has our nation's priorities exactly backward.
The most fundamental duty of government is to protect its citizens, so we should spend first on national security and then move down to lower priorities.
---
| As one [national newspaper](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001j6FoiwNQ7V4dm1st1eWYCOAbc8OFvdu3jQ6UzYLeJo-6bpxteHhR294HRY2g7fom-94o1ebSEebrX3pDzxdFrxj7Fk6w5N5Cv6aKBnl5CNSNukpXc-Sy7LvHavyA2-MbjmMPaYQuJq7eGnXLovDZ9xfM59qAjEfygoB-tB8a8tq3VtvgQerX_f0leFlL8gc8F6OjBQHzavREQ9uzJ6w0bOUleQzXJBZ61fyeDElIPCBxEpyzpJHjHpIi3KiUpOLWhBLNPKCKbJ0=&c=nqNFIBQN4MfCmDdw77SPtQHr5uyZv5IvUdQaopoFEPO7E2Z0t7s0aQ==&ch=fhkex0SaE_VVgW3vHxdZV_a9MhqjfPG6Ycn9uFo1-43FhPchcOWP7w==) noted, "The President's $850 billion request for the Pentagon in 2025 is a mere 1% increase over 2024. That's a cut after inflation, the fourth in a row Mr. Biden has proposed."
This compares with larger increases for agencies like EPA (8.4%), HUD (3.6%), and FAA (14%). This is a lot of money, of course, but factoring in inflation this is a defense budget cut in real dollars, historically low as a percentage of GDP, and just 12.3% of the overall federal budget.
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001j6FoiwNQ7V4dm1st1eWYCOAbc8OFvdu3jQ6UzYLeJo-6bpxteHhR21X3GsCXSd-5JbRVH7ntgGhtbogKmDimCqBc-XSQsEVNaPBPlUAYkMV-VEE3-haCD8U2tviaPk_Il2GKzizy1SWhRvkTUKb2Dp6KedSAzAW2WHCcmMRg4O71v5Vpd8CI7-8qLSzI4O0p&c=nqNFIBQN4MfCmDdw77SPtQHr5uyZv5IvUdQaopoFEPO7E2Z0t7s0aQ==&ch=fhkex0SaE_VVgW3vHxdZV_a9MhqjfPG6Ycn9uFo1-43FhPchcOWP7w==)
---
| It's a dangerous world out there, and the President's proposed defense budget doesn't face this reality. Take the rising threat from China. China is aggressively expanding its naval fleet, and now has nearly 80 more ships than the U.S. Navy, 370 to 291. China added 30 ships just in the last year, including an aircraft carrier and about a dozen cruisers and destroyers.
During the same time, the U.S. Navy added just two ships to its fleet and is set to shrink in the coming years as retirement of its inventory outpaces new construction."

---
| | [HELP PRIORITIZE OUR NATIONAL DEFENSE](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001j6FoiwNQ7V4dm1st1eWYCOAbc8OFvdu3jQ6UzYLeJo-6bpxteHhR27G1UmMW4mwIz2Ytoav_tsHamrcJ2fC3qCb8h_OOky6xXA2CTzmH46XMzE7vcZAiYM_jpvRWi1iFyaZwAf7QAgFCLGx1mYtQsvnxUkikrO_b8hSbKuhxO6DAaDcrZPH9mRQD9Wwwt45YTWCMvvZgGCDFGBe9-ThtydN8bdFIXkccsWza0AKfBiYOj05unyoI4KxcpE4M73aAGUqTon22S8rt9LDHPhqDGQ==&c=nqNFIBQN4MfCmDdw77SPtQHr5uyZv5IvUdQaopoFEPO7E2Z0t7s0aQ==&ch=fhkex0SaE_VVgW3vHxdZV_a9MhqjfPG6Ycn9uFo1-43FhPchcOWP7w==)
---
|
We're on the brink of being outgunned and outmanned in the Pacific, entering the most dangerous period of U.S.-China relations in history. Add to that hot wars raging in Ukraine and the Middle East, and this is no time to be drawing back on our national defense.
We have an [obligation](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001j6FoiwNQ7V4dm1st1eWYCOAbc8OFvdu3jQ6UzYLeJo-6bpxteHhR2y27OJa4L2Ew0hpfq3FQt7kubRDyn_Q6F-nOj-Z8nEkSLz3q0w7-5wHlUcF3y9S0d9S-YCAIVY0gpO7ZyOmEt6x3hVNAf6KdWT02kjq8Mf2Os95IjwVyGM0=&c=nqNFIBQN4MfCmDdw77SPtQHr5uyZv5IvUdQaopoFEPO7E2Z0t7s0aQ==&ch=fhkex0SaE_VVgW3vHxdZV_a9MhqjfPG6Ycn9uFo1-43FhPchcOWP7w==) to our men and women in uniform to ensure they have the tools and resources to remain the greatest fighting force in the world. And we have an obligation to the American people to ensure that we prioritize our national security above all else. The President's latest budget falls short of these obligations.

As always, never hesitate to [reach out](mailto:josh@paulhudsonforcongress.com).
Humbly, Paul

body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0p6cpoguJO4 [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0p6cpoguJO4]
Yesterday, I released a statement in response to the very disturbing comments my opponent Janelle Stelson made disparaging people of Asian descent. My statement is below. On live TV, Janelle made a joke that referenced Asian people eating cat tacos. It was a shocking and painful reminder of the insensitivity that has become far too commonplace in our national discourse. Something that MAGA Republicans like Scott Perry and Donald Trump far too often embrace.
You can listen to Janelle's comments HERE [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0p6cpoguJO4] .
I know what it’s like to be called names and to have jokes made about you. As someone who came to this country when I was 13, I know what it’s like to be on the receiving end of insensitive ‘jokes’ and comments.. That’s why I’m so grateful to be living the American Dream. After becoming a citizen and spending my career as an attorney for women and workers and now a Harrisburg City Councilwoman, I have the opportunity to continue my life of public service by running for Congress.
I’m running for Congress because the name calling and hurtful rhetoric needs to stop. Congressmen like Scott Perry are the problem and it’s going to take someone willing to stand up to him–and anyone else– and say enough is enough,
My campaign has never had the big wealthy donors that some of my opponents have. It does have supporters like you–who have continuously showed up and had my back.
I need your help again–can you support my campaign NOW with a contribution of $250, $100, $50 or whatever you can afford today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023?refcode=cattacos]
WIth less than 2 weeks to go before the primary election, your support is more important than ever.
With gratitude,
Shamaine
My statement:
Janelle Stelson, a Republican until last year, has spent this Primary trying to convince Democratic voters that she shares our values. Clearly she does not. Her comments are too offensive for Howard Stern, and that says a lot. Obviously, Stelson owes an apology to the Asian community. She also owes an apology to all of the people of PA-10 who have welcomed her as a guest. While Janelle does not live in PA-10, as a candidate for Congress in this district and a resident and on air personality in neighboring Lancaster County, her comments paint an ugly picture that does not reflect the welcoming, caring community I’m proud to call my home.
After a career spent reading other people’s words off of a teleprompter, we see what Janelle has to say when she doesn’t have a script. Now we understand why Janelle’s campaign kept her away from the numerous debates and forums held throughout the district during this primary season.
# # #

Dear Peter,
Our campaign is gaining significant momentum, and with each new ballot access victory, we’re moving closer to a historic win this November!
We’re excited to announce that Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. and Nicole Shanahan have secured spots on the ballots in North Carolina, Idaho, and most recently, Nebraska.
We kicked off our series of victories in North Carolina, where Team Kennedy's tireless efforts amassed over 23,000 signatures, far exceeding the required amount with a buffer exceeding 60%.
_The momentum didn't stop there_. In Idaho, our campaign doubled the necessary signatures, securing over 2,000 endorsements to place "Bobby on the Ballot."
And now, we are proud to announce our latest triumph in Nebraska. Our campaign has gathered more than 4,800 signatures, nearly doubling the requirement and ensuring RFK Jr.'s place on the Nebraska ballot.
These wins are more than just milestones—it's a clear indication that Americans across the country are rallying for change, for a new direction, and see Kennedy/Shanahan as the solution.
With North Carolina, Idaho, and now Nebraska under our belt, marking the seventh state where Kennedy has qualified, the message is clear: our campaign is a formidable force, resonating with Americans from all walks of life.
_But the fight is far from over_. Party bosses are determined to keep Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. and Nicole Shanahan off the ballot across the country.
Just as the DNC tried using underhanded tactics to keep us off the ballot in Nevada, _the political establishment is expected to continue forcing our hand by dragging us through costly court battles_.

name: CAPT Hung Cao
subject: The long journey to America
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia
body:
| | | Peter,
16 hours.

That’s the length of the plane ride from Vietnam to the island of Guam, a patch of American soil in the Pacific Ocean.

My family had escaped Communist Vietnam by the skin of our teeth, and we were on the way to a strange new place called America.

_But the second I stepped off that plane, I knew this country was different than the one I left._**
**
---
[](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=8bdd4b7b2ad14f749e1ba0a03bcae3b7&_e=Ox5GXhwFBeONCNMYaG2a7Mi0vJG1x5jzGei9y0XXkOxLnlVi2WkwnzYUFoV9A3n_srLQeUJurhHGVXZEZ7GbIXyOTcsejH_FMd21onsqE7_gt2KNOZdxviXfnzrkosGQxm00oIM1OtklQq8QNhpn-RvSG6Lyh8y38uZKYEx5nDqai8xvJjNj-mB6n28Z3WoGppJtuDLBiCt9SF_gMscjcd0Wxa86JUs_-At6nm3OmRxZ5gnbIsY0YiQzRy45A86F76ngykmolBGeSCj1v9_by320bg-lTkfzLvf0dhgz_aZ0A5wsTnyScFuRGu_A6xQOX93VETGZV6WuiJWVGw2DWu0Ixtfsribaa_VeJNkCgkI7WbAefFh5p4XBpRytP-yVkvcAk3Q-fSUWP471siwzCA%3D%3D)
---
Here, people weren’t afraid. The streets were vibrant with laughter. In America, I knew we were truly free.

Despite coming to this country not knowing a word of English, I dedicated every second of my time learning how to become an American.

I knew I owed my life to this country, so at just 18 years old, I decided to dedicate my life to serving it. I was appointed to the U.S. Naval Academy, and after graduating, served as a Captain in the Navy for 25 years.
---
[](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=8bdd4b7b2ad14f749e1ba0a03bcae3b7&_e=Ox5GXhwFBeONCNMYaG2a7Mi0vJG1x5jzGei9y0XXkOxLnlVi2WkwnzYUFoV9A3n_srLQeUJurhHGVXZEZ7GbIXyOTcsejH_FMd21onsqE7_gt2KNOZdxviXfnzrkosGQxm00oIM1OtklQq8QNhpn-RvSG6Lyh8y38uZKYEx5nDqai8xvJjNj-mB6n28Z3WoGppJtuDLBiCt9SF_gMscjcd0Wxa86JUs_-At6nm3OmRxZ5gnbIsY0YiQzRy45A86Fz-Fz2RdTsBNDLvqEHhfyh7RlSlAhWJVyD79CjRFAwTh-4EmLy2DSVU0K9T44aRyoit3A_z9KC9Fg63FXc0399ZUY8kTRtgpclEoOs_hqKSg0KAzeFDla31zWmiZ4hxqgRdVWw1eJzjWwNW38DDOyAg%3D%3D)
---
My years on the front lines of combat weren’t easy. There were many months away from my family. I pushed my body and my mind to the limit. There were times where I didn’t know if I’d get out alive.

_But it was worth it, because I was defending the country I loved and keeping the American Dream alive for my family._

Today, my service in the Navy may be over, but I’m not done fighting for our country.

**I’m running for U.S. Senate in Virginia because Joe Biden is ERADICATING the same values that my fellow soldiers and I put our lives on the line for.**

I believe our families deserve better than failing and aging career politicians. _Our country deserves better._
---
[](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=8bdd4b7b2ad14f749e1ba0a03bcae3b7&_e=Ox5GXhwFBeONCNMYaG2a7Mi0vJG1x5jzGei9y0XXkOxLnlVi2WkwnzYUFoV9A3n_srLQeUJurhHGVXZEZ7GbIXyOTcsejH_FMd21onsqE7_gt2KNOZdxviXfnzrkosGQxm00oIM1OtklQq8QNhpn-RvSG6Lyh8y38uZKYEx5nDqai8xvJjNj-mB6n28Z3WoGppJtuDLBiCt9SF_gMscjcd0Wxa86JUs_-At6nm3OmRxZ5gnbIsY0YiQzRy45A86Fg5tPrGRO4nJuX1WFOL0MLfpeZp5hJ3IQYEgXPryWx0z5d0hzhyRrWa7vXCqNkdJIxEERsMCaBzipSl2inrOXpFwyE6beD5Abnu-VSBVGR8idwaUHV469xec5zdWu4DqGTghQWHdGRhJctL2KgBAKDA%3D%3D)
---
I’ll never give up on the country that saved my life, and I hope you’ll join me in my mission to save America.

**[**Will you join our team today to bring Virginia the REAL representation they deserve?**](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=8bdd4b7b2ad14f749e1ba0a03bcae3b7&_e=Ox5GXhwFBeONCNMYaG2a7Mi0vJG1x5jzGei9y0XXkOxLnlVi2WkwnzYUFoV9A3n_srLQeUJurhHGVXZEZ7GbIXyOTcsejH_FMd21onsqE7_gt2KNOZdxviXfnzrkosGQxm00oIM1OtklQq8QNhpn-RvSG6Lyh8y38uZKYEx5nDqai8xvJjNj-mB6n28Z3WoGppJtuDLBiCt9SF_gMscjcd0Wxa86JUs_-At6nm3OmRxZ5gnbIsY0YiQzRy45A86F4gHHWpFB6Je1LhInTnDLmF38vVG8sHgRp1Fsg3sOkJ-NHdkexgtiWS9DRbQQgB6j_M4pkwyJnNK2NHOqSxfFzaEFe-VEeITH0t6fkIHrMT_k5D92aVOCtqrGx0XN1XSJVidgIWybj4Q15-Ka-E7JIA%3D%3D)**
---
[**JOIN THE TEAM**](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=8bdd4b7b2ad14f749e1ba0a03bcae3b7&_e=Ox5GXhwFBeONCNMYaG2a7Mi0vJG1x5jzGei9y0XXkOxLnlVi2WkwnzYUFoV9A3n_srLQeUJurhHGVXZEZ7GbIXyOTcsejH_FMd21onsqE7_gt2KNOZdxviXfnzrkosGQxm00oIM1OtklQq8QNhpn-RvSG6Lyh8y38uZKYEx5nDqai8xvJjNj-mB6n28Z3WoGppJtuDLBiCt9SF_gMscjcd0Wxa86JUs_-At6nm3OmRxZ5gnbIsY0YiQzRy45A86FMACCsIICha3CC3W7HJQcZqAgrvJOJeGWLw4X5SdtrF8Pkv-9eg6RSXxYWTepn2nDwCPBnsgDNNfGGJMS-yQiaPZ_OKCowBmQXwxN_bK79xrNzdzaILq2b7hJKzOxiDWCS7yLgjzoQrH2COGwTcXy4w%3D%3D)
---
In Liberty,

[](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=8bdd4b7b2ad14f749e1ba0a03bcae3b7&_e=Ox5GXhwFBeONCNMYaG2a7Mi0vJG1x5jzGei9y0XXkOxLnlVi2WkwnzYUFoV9A3n_srLQeUJurhHGVXZEZ7GbIXyOTcsejH_FMd21onsqE7_gt2KNOZdxviXfnzrkosGQxm00oIM1OtklQq8QNhpn-RvSG6Lyh8y38uZKYEx5nDqai8xvJjNj-mB6n28Z3WoGppJtuDLBiCt9SF_gMscjcd0Wxa86JUs_-At6nm3OmRxZ5gnbIsY0YiQzRy45A86FMhp5UiWqHWe-_KllxOi4Ms8H5QhYPjxUm_VvNXrw7XlkGlnZKU8ma2g9Ww-YYFgyUcSVEc-KSs81jbdukUGdptxMQ4Bf3x7Tb4x7dOt-zV6rfvgW2ph_aYXa1CGR26URBjdVoKmcqFFJSozpWQ-VBw%3D%3D)

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Sign the petition to protect female athletes
body:
The National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA) just banned men who pretend to be women from competing in women’s sports.

| |
---
| | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2znmg6a3cqnqpnlcg5l5kvmgffhpi1ivuk95a3pt0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32c3im6or6cdh2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, The National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA) just banned men who pretend to be women from competing in women’s sports.Now I’m asking you to sign this emergency petition demanding the National Collegiate Athletic Association – widely known as the NCAA – do the same. **[Will you take 30 seconds right now to add your name to the BAN MEN FROM WOMEN’S SPORTS Petition?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z4c6brigqd7maff5a9mekrnf836b3qnbv64i95dg_rp22sh2s8i6ep32c3im6or6cdh2bs)** My goal is to collect 1,000,000 signatures to send to NCAA President Charlie Baker in the next few weeks. As the attorney of three young women who were coerced by medical professionals into taking puberty-blocking drugs, pumping their bodies full of cross-sex hormones, and amputating their healthy breasts when they were barely teenagers......**I know just how dangerous it is for an influential organization like the NCAA to glorify medically transitioning children.** As a woman, I understand how unsafe it can be to force girls to share a locker room and other vulnerable spaces with men.And as a conservative, I recognize that it’s a violation of our constitutional freedoms for the “transgender” movement to ignore obvious distinctions between men and women —erasing equal opportunities that real women fought so hard to achieve and pass to future generations of women. **[This is why I’m urgently asking you to add your name to the BAN MEN FROM WOMEN’S SPORTS Petition right away.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1d3qd5v43dagkis8km5kl6uk3n7cqcucvhq99q0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32c3im6or6cdh2bs)** My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I’m the CEO and Founder of the **_Center for American Liberty_** – a conservative not-for-profit law firm that is leading the charge against the woke transgender agenda.
---
* We’re suing Kaiser Permanente and the child mutilators who medically transitioned Chloe Cole to a “boy” when she was just 13 years old. **_Chloe did not give informed consent and now faces a lifetime of serious medical issues because of the drugs, hormones, and surgeries forced on her._**
* We just sent a demand letter on behalf of a grandmother who was banned for life from her local YMCA because she confronted a man in the ladies’ locker room – who was wearing a women’s bathing suit and watching two little girls undress. **_The YMCA called the police on Julie, demonized her in the community, and banished her from the pool she frequented for 40 years._**
* And we’re headed to the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals for a major hearing in the case of a California mother whose daughter was secretly transitioned to a “boy” at school. The fifth-grade child was given a new name, new pronouns, and new bathroom—all without so much as a phone call to mom for her permission. **_This radical school district robbed her mother, Aurora Regino, of her God-given parental rights to raise her child the way she sees fit._**

---
| | I won’t mince words... Robbing women of equal opportunities in college athletics AND forcing them to share locker rooms and showers with males is unacceptable. But that’s exactly what the NCAA is doing.It’s an attack on the God-given rights and constitutional freedoms of every American.And it’s up to you and me to stop it. Right here, right now. **[That’s why after signing the BAN MEN FROM WOMEN’S SPORTS Petition, I ask that you make a tax-deductible donation of $25 to the _Center for American Liberty._](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2i9sdg7nf9o676b3h98jl4tf4so14vl4blfso9o_rp22sh2s8i6ep32c3im6or6cdh2bs)** Your generous support will ensure we have the resources to win our groundbreaking litigation on behalf of Chloe, Julie, Aurora, and many others.More importantly, your signature on this vital petition will send a clear message – not just to the leaders in college athletics but to every radical leading a school district, hospital, or athletic facility in America – that you won’t tolerate this lunacy a moment longer.**[So please follow this link to sign the BAN MEN FROM WOMEN’S SPORTS Petition and make your best tax-deductible donation right away.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5ei7gv61ovc4de9re4b0huech1r19v0sinre2o0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32c3im6or6cdh2bs)** If the NAIA can protect women’s sports, so can the NCAA.

Let’s build off this momentum. Thank you in advance for your support.
---
God Bless,
---

Dear Pro-Life American,

A disheartening reality is unfolding before us.

America, a nation built on freedom and the right to life, is threatened by disturbing policies that endanger thousands of unborn babies. The Biden Administration's policies are catalyzing the most pro-abortion administration we've ever seen.

Biden supports heart-wrenching late-term abortions, encourages cover-up of infanticide, endorses unrestricted access to abortion drugs, and is determined to establish abortion-on-demand in our Constitution.

In essence, his administration serves death rather than life, leaving thousands of unborn babies and vulnerable women at risk.

We at SBA Pro-Life America envision a world where every life is cherished. Where pain, despair, and death are replaced by compassion, support, and life. But this vision requires your unwavering support right now.

It's not just about standing against policies; it's about standing for lives - your life, my life, our children's lives, and those precious babies who are yet to be born.

We believe in the power of collective action. Join us as we champion the cause for life, rise above partisan politics, and fight against the deadly agenda of Big Abortion. You, as an individual, hold a powerful weapon - your voice. Use it in defense of those who cannot defend themselves before it's too late.

Time is ticking and we need you to take action TODAY!

Tell Joe Biden NO! No to unrestricted access to abortion drugs. No to painful late-term abortions. No to abortion-on-demand.

Help us serve women, save babies, and protect America by turning down the most pro-abortion administration in history! Together, we can leave a legacy of life and love for future generations.

For Life,

Marjorie Dannenfelser

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: a dark day
body:
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1fc21b08-648a-4eb4-87e6-987472d0da17/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|

| | | | | Peter, I am incredibly disappointed. This week, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born. They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War. No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest. As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass. It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance. It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over. If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster. I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign. [**Split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action today and we will direct every dollar you send to us towards defeating Kari Lake and Donald Trump in Arizona. Any amount helps.** ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T05c82c36-5779-48a5-9b72-bdc91edc86f7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. More than 23,000 donations were made to my campaign in March with **an average gift of $26**. And let me tell you that while $21 goes a long way in helping us to reach the voters we need to continue winning elections - not as many people are donating to campaigns like mine as they once did.**In fact, our fundraising numbers are down 84% in the first 11 days of April compared to the first 11 days of March.**

Some political pundits have written articles that spell doom for Republican candidates, opining that conservative candidates/causes have inundated you with too many texts and too much email to sift through in a day. While It’s true that nearly every congressional campaign in the 2024 cycle will attempt to utilize online fundraising to propel them into the House/Senate, not every email or text is created equal; and **not every email or text will deliver the entirety of your donation to the candidate you think you’re donating to.**

Bad actors and political grifters have figured out that online fundraising is a good way to make a quick buck off your generosity. **Not me. Not now, not ever.**

I know a couple of things to be true:
* We must do everything within our power to hold onto the U.S. House – the future of our country absolutely depends on it

* **Democrats are outraising Republicans 2-1 most months, sometimes it can even be as high as 3-1**

Friend, I wanted to reach out this afternoon because we have an important deadline coming up. I'm about to ask you to help me hit my $50,000 daily fundraising goal. But first, I want to tell you a story about doughnuts — and how they're going to help us save our Senate majority.
**[(If you're short on time and ready to retire Rick Scott this fall, you can chip in here to help me make up this fundraising gap and flip Florida blue.)](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82819707/466399680/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1005-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTM1NjdhOWEtMGVmOC1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=q96tL9-IklSmesMNBPKqvFffwOB5CFlr2jlsFZqTdbo=)**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82819708/466399681/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1005-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTM1NjdhOWEtMGVmOC1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=q96tL9-IklSmesMNBPKqvFffwOB5CFlr2jlsFZqTdbo=)
When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and _still_ struggling to afford rent for our small, one room apartment.
**So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop.** It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.
We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. I’m not the typical person in Congress.
I was the first person in my family to graduate from college, and I chose to be a pediatrician in Adams County to give back to my community and the folks that raised me. I quickly realized the obstacles faced by doctors trying to help children in our communities.
That’s why I ran for the state legislature. In that time, I passed legislation to force drug companies to lower the cost of prescriptions, expand funding for preschool, ensure all Coloradans have access to paid family leave and sick days, and protect renters from eviction during the pandemic.
And, Peter, I ran for Congress in 2022 to continue fighting for Colorado’s kids and families. The pollsters called this race a long shot. Thanks to this grassroots team, we defied the odds and elected the first Latina from Colorado to Congress.
I want you to know that I remain deeply committed to Colorado's families, drawing from my own journey that mirrors the aspirations and hurdles of many in our state. My resolve to keep up our work and achieve real change for us all is unwavering.
I will continue to fight to lower health care costs, address the high cost of living, and protect a woman’s right to choose. Not just because it’s what's popular, but because I know it’s what folks all across our community and country need.

Fellow American, Did you know that many public universities require students to take Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) classes to graduate? **These aren’t just private institutions – many of them are public schools that use YOUR tax dollars!** That’s what a new report released by Speech First found after investigating hundreds of colleges and universities across all 50 states and Washington, DC. Speech First****– one of the nation's leading campus free speech advocacy groups – is fighting back against Woke Colleges – and we need your support! **[**Stand with Speech First and use your voice to demand accountability from these Universities that are silencing student voices. By signing our petition, you are calling out the absurd DEI requirements of these schools.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjQ4MjQ4In0/dPh8UejtHE6X04iQJ2Zpyw)**

It’s a story that has become all too familiar in our current age: A young student -- maybe even your own child or grandchild -- goes off to college for their first semester. Then, just a few months later, they return home changed. Their entire worldview has shifted into categories of race, class, gender, status... they're being transformed by the DEI system. _Sadly, two-thirds of the 248 colleges investigated by Speech First mandate DEI “education" for their students, and millions of families are dealing with its effects each year._ The Woke Left has secured a tyrannical grip on our nation's higher education system. This is nothing short of indoctrination into the toxic ideology of Critical Race Theory and the suppression of free thought. Our exhaustive report found that major public schools like West Virginia University, Oklahoma State University, University of Utah, University of Montana, University of Arizona, Oregon State University, and Western Kentucky University all have DEI requirements to graduate. **[**Please take a moment right now to sign our petition and hold these Woke Universities accountable for their actions. Your voice is crucial in sending a message that this suppression of free speech will not be tolerated.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjQ4MjQ4In0/IPZEASk7RbqK76_TBVyA8Q)**

Last year, while serving in the Mississippi Legislature, I had a discussion about Medicaid expansion with a county administrator from the Mississippi Delta. This county, which lacks both a hospital and private clinics, established a medical clinic to serve its citizens. As an economically disadvantaged area, the clinic caters exclusively to patients with Medicaid insurance.
During our discussion, the county administrator mentioned that Medicaid's reimbursement rates do not cover the full cost of patient care. As a result, the county is currently required to fund the clinic with approximately two million dollars per year to bridge the gap. The administrator also expressed concern that if the clinic is mandated to see more patients through Medicaid expansion, the county's inability to further supplement the clinic's funding could potentially lead to its closure.
Expanding Medicaid will not address the challenges faced by rural hospitals or rural healthcare. Providing able-bodied adults with taxpayer-funded insurance will divert resources away from those in dire need.
The advocacy for Medicaid expansion by hospitals stems from their desire to dominate the healthcare market within the state. Larger hospitals, with a significant number of private insurance patients, can absorb losses and use the expansion as an opportunity to grow their system, reduce competition, and increase healthcare costs for all patients.
Expanding Medicaid will have negative consequences for various stakeholders:
1. Rural healthcare patients: Medicaid expansion will not address the specific challenges faced by rural healthcare systems, potentially leading to the closure of essential services in these areas.
2. Poor citizens, women, and children: The diversion of resources to able-bodied adults will result in reduced care for those who are truly in need.
3. Taxpayers and private insured: The expansion will lead to higher taxes to fund the program and increased healthcare costs for private insurance holders, as larger hospitals raise prices to compensate for losses from Medicaid patients.

There are alternative approaches to addressing the needs of citizens living in rural areas and those who are uninsured, rather than expanding Medicaid. I addressed this issue in my article about repealing [Certificate of Need Laws](https://substack.com/redirect/f9885b7b-a279-470b-9edd-5ceb54da0403?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

As an economically disadvantaged area, the clinic caters exclusively to patients with Medicaid insurance. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? from the desk ofDana Criswell | | | Apr 11 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Last year, while serving in the Mississippi Legislature, I had a discussion about Medicaid expansion with a county administrator from the Mississippi Delta. This county, which lacks both a hospital and private clinics, established a medical clinic to serve its citizens. As an economically disadvantaged area, the clinic caters exclusively to patients with Medicaid insurance. During our discussion, the county administrator mentioned that Medicaid's reimbursement rates do not cover the full cost of patient care. As a result, the county is currently required to fund the clinic with approximately two million dollars per year to bridge the gap. The administrator also expressed concern that if the clinic is mandated to see more patients through Medicaid expansion, the county's inability to further supplement the clinic's funding could potentially lead to its closure. Expanding Medicaid will not address the challenges faced by rural hospitals or rural healthcare. Providing able-bodied adults with taxpayer-funded insurance will divert resources away from those in dire need. The advocacy for Medicaid expansion by hospitals stems from their desire to dominate the healthcare market within the state. Larger hospitals, with a significant number of private insurance patients, can absorb losses and use the expansion as an opportunity to grow their system, reduce competition, and increase healthcare costs for all patients. Expanding Medicaid will have negative consequences for various stakeholders: 1. Rural healthcare patients: Medicaid expansion will not address the specific challenges faced by rural healthcare systems, potentially leading to the closure of essential services in these areas. 2. Poor citizens, women, and children: The diversion of resources to able-bodied adults will result in reduced care for those who are truly in need. 3. Taxpayers and private insured: The expansion will lead to higher taxes to fund the program and increased healthcare costs for private insurance holders, as larger hospitals raise prices to compensate for losses from Medicaid patients. There are alternative approaches to addressing the needs of citizens living in rural areas and those who are uninsured, rather than expanding Medicaid. subject: Join our Listen & Learn
body:

|

| Peter, Bill Spadea here, and I've got something important to share with you. We're gearing up for our next Listen & Learn session, and you won't want to miss it. **Mark your calendars for this coming Monday, April 15th at 7 PM.** We'll be gathering at the East Hanover Elks, located at 1 Kane Pl, East Hanover, NJ 07936-1201, for an evening of conversation, insight, and actionable knowledge. This time, we're tackling an urgent national emergency that's hitting close to home for every American – the border crisis. Fresh off my journey to the southern border, I've seen with my own eyes the severity of what's unfolding. This isn't just a crisis; it's an outright invasion that's undermining our public safety, jeopardizing public health, and tearing at the very seams of our communities.

---
|
---
Our discussion will not only shed light on what's happening at the border but also explore the broader implications for our state and country. From public safety to public health, and from the harrowing realities of human and drug trafficking to the quest for a secure nation, we'll cover it all.
So, why should you join us?

---
| **Because this is more than just a meeting; it's a chance to engage, ask questions, and become part of a community that's eager to learn and take action.** It's an opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of the issues from someone who's seen them up close. Don't just hear about it from the sidelines; be part of the conversation that moves us toward solutions. Be there at the East Hanover Elks on April 15th at 7 PM. Together, we can navigate these challenging topics and work towards a better, safer New Jersey. Looking forward to seeing you there, Bill Spadea

As the most viable and electable Democrat to face Bergman in November, Bob Lorinser needs our help to ensure victory for the people this August.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Bob%20Resize.jpeg]
Very rarely does a first-time candidate have a competitive chance against an incumbent. But the good news is Bob does. It's only possible with grassroots contributions. Thank you. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
Friends,
As a second-time candidate on the tail end of a two-cycle strategy to defeat Trumpism in rural Michigan, Bob Lorinser is honored with the advantage of name recognition and momentum. He doesn't take it for granted because it's derived from supporters like you.
The last repeat Democratic candidate who rematched a GOP incumbent in Congress here gained 10 points by running a second time.
That year, Democrats came within half a percentage point of defeating the sitting Republican in Northern Michigan and the UP.
This year will be our year, but we must energize, organize, and mobilize.
Friends, Jack Bergman has never faced a second-time challenger, and Bob is more motivated than ever to take him on again this November.
Considering unfavorable redistricting, in the last cycle, our campaign already moved the needle for Democrats by 5 points. Still, Michigan's 1st District will only garner national support if Democrats come out in full force for Bob in the primary.
Let us show ourselves — and others — who we are and shout it from the rooftops like Bob shouts Medicare for All, a labor revolution, affordable housing, education, childcare, and so much more.
Let's use our grit and tenacity to make a difference. This election is too important to abandon our momentum.
Join us.
Onward,

I have some very exciting news that greatly increases our chances of success. In NJ, the Democratic Party has historically chosen slates of candidates in the Democratic Primary and supported them with intense marketing campaigns. This was always an uphill battle, but this ruling gives us a real leveling of the playing field. Please donate if you can and I hope that you and your loved ones are well.
Best,
Kyle

VOTE TODAY! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Make%20A%20Plan%20To%20Vote.png]
You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/VWCC.jpeg] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC
Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.

Bring your walking shoes, a charged cell phone, and water. When you arrive to their launch location you will receive a brief training and literature before being sent out to turf. Questions? Email Beth at egunter3@gmail.com [egunter3@gmail.com] or call 540-353-3645.

Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

Meetings occur on the first Monday and third Sunday of every month in person and virtually. The goal of RYD is to help improve our community and to promote the names of Democratic candidates and policies.

name: Jamison Carrier for Congress
subject: Law Enforcement's Choice
body:
| | | |
---
| The momentum behind our campaign is growing by the day. As a businessman and the only true outsider in the race for the Sixth Congressional District, I'm honored to have the support of law enforcement leaders from all across the district.
---
| "As your Sheriff, I know firsthand the issues facing our families and communities in Johnson County with drugs and crime coming from our southern border. We need a strong partner in Congress to help us protect our citizens, so I am proud to endorse Jamison Carrier for Congress.
Jamison knows the consequences of Biden's Border Crisis and will fight every day to protect all Hoosiers. It is personal to him. He will be a strong voice for law enforcement and his constituents across the Sixth Congressional District. I urge all Johnson County residents to vote for Jamison Carrier for Congress in the Republican primary on May 7th." ~ Duane Burgess, Johnson County Sheriff
---
|
---
| |
---
| "I am proud to support Jamison Carrier for Congress in the Sixth Congressional District. Jamison is a Hoosier who grew up in Richmond and is a long-time Johnson County resident. He is a man of faith, a family man, and has been personally affected by our crisis at the border. As your Prosecutor, I know first-hand the issues the border has caused around the country and right here at home. Jamison is the leader we need right now in Washington." ~ Lance Hamner, Johnson County Prosecutor
---
|
---
| |
---
| "As the Sheriff of Bartholomew County, I've seen first-hand the effects of Biden's border crisis. Deadly drugs and crime are flowing from our southern border to communities across our state. Jamison Carrier's family has been personally affected, and his resolve to find a solution to secure our border is stronger than anyone running for office in Indiana. He will support law enforcement, be tough on crime and drugs, and fight every day to protect our communities. I am proud to support his campaign for Congress." ~ Chris Lane, Bartholomew County Sheriff
---
|
---
| |
---
| "Fentanyl coming across our border is a major problem for our community and others across our state. We need a partner in Congress who knows how this affects Hoosier families and who will be a strong voice to find a solution. Jamison Carrier is that candidate. I am honored to support Jamison because this crisis is personal to him. His determination to hold those accountable for poisoning our children is commendable, and I look forward to partnering with him once elected." ~ Lindsey Holden-Kay, Bartholomew County Prosecutor
---
|
---
| |
---
| "In a world that seems to be upside down and out of control, it's of utmost importance to have someone who is a conservative and is passionate about gun rights and the sanctity of human life. I am pleased to announce my endorsement of Jamison Carrier as a candidate for the United States Congress here in the Sixth District of Indiana." ~ Jeffrey Wayne Adams, Union County Sheriff
---
|
---
| |
---
| "Sixth District communities, families, law enforcement, and first responders need an advocate in DC who will fight for all of us. An advocate who will remember us and fight for our brothers, sisters, and friends who are struggling and who have been forgotten and overlooked in Washington for too long. Jamison Carrier is that advocate. I endorse Jamison Carrier for Congress. I ask that you please vote for him to help the 6th District have the help and advocacy our communities need in Washington, DC." ~ Brent Eaton, Hancock County Prosecutor

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Joe Biden took a HUGE step forward on background checks today
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
You are going to want to see this
#

Friends -
Today, I am proud to share news of a major victory in our movement for gun safety—a victory we’ve been fighting for since GIFFORDS was founded eleven years ago.
President Joe Biden just took bold action and finalized a rule to address a gaping loophole that allowed firearm dealers to sell guns without performing background checks and let anyone intent on doing harm to buy a gun, no questions asked.
For the past eleven years, since a minority of senators blocked commonsense background checks legislation, I have called on multiple presidential administrations to expand background checks by executive action. And today, President Biden delivered.
This new rule is simple: if you sell guns like a brick-and-mortar gun dealer, you have to conduct background checks like licensed gun dealers do. It goes a long way toward addressing the online and gun show loopholes.
After the ATF announced this proposed rule, our movement drove more than 300,000 public comments in support. YOU helped make this happen.
We are closer than ever to universal background checks. Fewer people will slip through the cracks, and we’re all safer for it.
But we can't stop now. We have to make sure President Biden is re-elected so these rules aren't overturned. And we need a Congress with the courage to finish the job and pass universal background checks once and for all.
So I am asking:

We will put your donation to work making sure we are passing more laws nationally and in states that make our communities safer from gun violence.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-apr24.Y_Rik7&refcode=em240411-1-30&t=1&akid=7932%2E3935704%2EWA5TMK)
