subject: Shelby County Republican Party News (April 2024)
body:
Hello Shelby County Patriots,

Here are five (5) Shelby County Republican Party highlights for you.

(1) Lincoln Day Dinner on May 9th

We’d love to have you join us in just over four (4) short weeks for our annual Lincoln Day Dinner. Flyer is attached. Please bring a crowd and let’s start getting geared up for the November election.

(2) Shelby County Republican Central Committee

All of our Central Committee positions were on the March 19th ballot, so we had a reorganization meeting on April 4th. Please see the attached Central Committee Roster and pay special attention to the vacancies on the committee. If your precinct is empty, and you’d like to serve on the Shelby County Republican Party’s leadership team, please let us know.

(3) November Presidential Election

I’ve decided that every election will be more important than the last for the rest of my life. That pattern has been unbroken for as long as I can remember now. Fighting “progressives” is like that though, isn’t it? They will never be satisfied, and will always be fighting to implement a way of life that is antithetical to what freedom-loving, small-government, conservatives cherish. Two major tasks in November will be to remove Joe Biden and Sherrod Brown from office. They have been in government 54 and 49 years respectively. It’s time they go. We must also prevent leftist liberals from taking over the Ohio Supreme Court. Three conservative Republican seats are on the ballot, and if the liberals win one of them, the balance will shift to a progressive activist agenda. Please come to our Lincoln Day Dinner to learn more!

(4) County Elected Officials

The March 19th Primary resulted in quite a few “unopposed” races for Shelby County in November. Please take a look at the attached Elected Official Roster for a snapshot of what’s going on in the county.

(5) 200 Club

This is our sole fundraiser each year to fund the operations of the Shelby County Republican Party. If you plan to contribute this year, please do so before the Lincoln Day Dinner so you can be in our drawing. I’ve attached a contribution form. If you’re not sure whether you’ve already contributed for this year or not, please send Dan ([cecilda.usaf@gmail.com](mailto:cecilda.usaf@gmail.com)) or Dennis ([dgrandey@gmail.com](mailto:dgrandey@gmail.com)) an email and we’ll check the records for you.

Cheers...Dan Cecil
Chairman
(937) 206-2970
[cecilda.usaf@gmail.com](mailto:cecilda.usaf@gmail.com)

Four (4) Attachments
LDD Flyer
CC Roster
Elected Officials
200 Club Form

clean_body: Friend, Last Friday, April 5th, President Biden visited Baltimore to show support after the collapse of the Key Memorial Bridge. He called on Congress to deliver funding from the federal government to cover the full cost of repairs of the bridge. Not only that, but he is showing great compassion for the people who are suffering from this great tragedy. “Your nation has your back,” President Biden said during his speech. These words resonate and the support of our fellow citizens in a tragedy as large as this means the world to us. We are grateful to President Biden for extending a hand and assisting Baltimore and the state of Maryland in a time of tragedy. His show of compassion, consoling the families of victims, means more than words can express. In times of crisis, community is all we can ask for. President Biden has shown us that. We want to thank him for taking the time to come to Baltimore. We are grateful for his leadership and empathy. We are Maryland Tough, Baltimore Strong. Together, we can get through this crisis. Thank you, Team Wes =

Friend, We don't know what else to do here. Former Trump Ambassador Richard Grenell reached out. Arkansas Senator Tom Cotton reached out. Former US Secretary of State Mike Pompeo reached out. Hear directly from members of the Squad, including Reps. Ilhan Omar, Cori Bush, Ayanna Pressley, Jamaal Bowman, Summer Lee, and Delia Ramirez, as they discuss our movement’s biggest challenge yet, and how we intend to defeat it. It’s not too late to RSVP. With critical primaries kicking off in just a few days, it’s time to ramp up our organizing nationwide to make sure we can take on groups like AIPAC and the Republican megadonors who fund them — and protect our champions in Congress from the relentless attacks headed their way. — Team WFP \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Team WFP Date: April 9, 2024 Subject: Join us and members of the Squad this Thursday Peter, Over the last few years we’ve been able to help elect a growing, dynamic group of working families champions to Congress. These victories — some against all odds — have built up our governing power as a movement and have had a real impact on people’s lives. But this power that we are building together has not gone unnoticed. And over the next few weeks, some of our strongest champions in Congress will face their biggest challenges yet. From now through November, the Working Families Party and our champions in Congress are going to face a barrage of attacks from Republican megadonors and their allies who have planned to spend more than $100 million in Democratic primaries to tear down what we are building — and ultimately to put MAGA back in full control of Congress and the White House. We can’t afford to lose any ground to the right-wing at a moment like this. That’s why, this Thursday, we are joining members of the Squad and allies for a special livestream event to kick off our efforts to defend the progress we’ve fought so hard to win. Can’t make it? ## **IV3 Launch Success-More Trainings Announced!**
In a giant leap forward for election integrity, True the Vote recently hosted a stellar introductory webinar for our IV3 platform, with attendance of 872 dedicated volunteers ready to help eclipse ineligible voter records (very punny, we know ... 😉 )
This will be the first of several IV3 trainings, so if you missed the last one, no worries, there will be more to follow.

IV3 offers users a powerful toolkit to confirm the accuracy of voter rolls, pinpoint ineligible records, report findings to local authorities, and stay on top of changes in their local voter registries. By empowering voters with the tools they need to take a proactive stance in the validation of voter rolls, True the Vote is laying the groundwork for a more transparent and accurate electoral process.
We have been overwhelmed by the number of people interested in using IV3! While we are thrilled by the response, we had to quickly develop an efficient onboarding process for the now **nearly 40,000 people** who’ve signed up to participate, which caused a slight delay in sending out registration links. The good news is we expect to send out registration emails starting tomorrow! If you’ve signed up, please look for an email coming from******[info@iv3.us](mailto:info@iv3.us)****.**

## **Analyzing the Spin at Rolling Stone**
Rolling Stone Magazine recently ran an article entitled, [Biden Is Building a ‘Superstructure’ to Stop Trump From Stealing the Election](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.UJcOIEsxQ3qr5lEWJDDC4pmkjjgyWcP2BpVeoBylZkADZtqMwdMqHDibQro9NzLFwnSF1iSrQCgJcRALxFXFRSczlx_bgvEBbvYeBFWlIeIkm1iS-iLg0LaUDiAcRaoEnhQdLLV5lQnCal0-MPWozXFX_cJj8Ndt4cbFNbJbsI5YDVIkOjpFCGpO3wEk9lh9EjyZFmj6iCL9fZCvZIzK3gkPiuw8AE_TIB7t5OdhYllecw3pI3IPrfLUJXVrgnWSjfRORxS_HGQVTh1Pr5whir4mN2AUV4MG0GZadUHxUT3vdjaFbve_HWxjFS4WjcOivPyyGj_ObCYRjet9MYLcBw/45f/KMlxBURxQSqPWFPTRCfQTA/h6/h001.h3y7H-lxOFcxdr8RAdqDkRI11Fck3AgQfHyCG5M_7JI), into which the authors injected the narrative with some very perceivable and predictable leftist bias. The article misrepresented federal election integrity efforts so completely that it necessitated a response.
Throughout the article, the writers wring their hands over the adequacy of the measures taken by the Biden campaign to counteract Donald Trump's influence on election integrity. However, the portrayal oversimplifies and grossly misrepresents the multifaceted efforts aimed at ensuring the security and fairness of American electoral processes.
Trump’s engagement with the electoral system over the years, misrepresented by Rolling Stone as being undermining, has actually led to heightened scrutiny and improvements in election security and integrity. Data cited in the article from the U.S. Election Assistance Commission indicates that roughly 28 million mail-in ballots have disappeared over the course of a decade. This underscores not a critique of Trump's approach, but rather illustrates one of the many systemic vulnerabilities that the Trump administration sought to address. President Trump’s efforts ranged from establishing a Commission on Voter Fraud to the enactment of Executive Order 13800 aimed at bolstering cybersecurity, reflecting a comprehensive strategy to safeguard electoral processes from interference and fraud.
Rolling Stone’s narrative that Trump’s post-2020 election actions were solely designed to delegitimize Biden’s presidency overlooks the pre-existing legal challenges initiated by his campaign against states over election management issues. These challenges were rooted in concerns over election integrity, particularly around mail-in ballots and voter verification processes. Highlighting specific cases where Trump's legal team secured victories underscores the substance behind some of their claims, challenging the broad-stroke dismissal of these efforts as baseless or nefarious.
The portrayal of Trump’s response to the 2020 election outcome, especially the legal battles that ensued, fails to acknowledge the nuanced context in which these actions were taken. While numerous lawsuits were dismissed, the reasons for dismissal and the nature of the allegations brought forth speak to deeper, systemic issues within the U.S. electoral framework that merit serious consideration, regardless of partisan affiliation.
The article's discussion of the January 6th events and subsequent politicization offers another dimension where the narrative diverges from a comprehensive understanding of the events. By examining a broader array of sources and accounts, such as the documentary "J6: A True Timeline," a more complex picture emerges, one that challenges the cynical, partisan portrayal of Trump as the instigator. The examination of Trump’s calls for peace and order during the events at the capitol, juxtaposed against the actions and treatment of certain individuals in the media, politicians, and our judicial system, only further exposed existing biases. Of course, none of this was taken into account by Rolling Stone.
The framing of Trump’s pre-election comments about the 2020 election integrity and the DNC's strategies for voter mobilization and litigation against Trump paints a picture of a deeply polarized political landscape, where actions and intentions are often interpreted through a lens of partisan bias. The emphasis on voter mobilization efforts by the DNC, while critiqued as focusing on demographic advantages rather than electoral integrity, points to broader issues of trust and confidence in the electoral system that transcend individual campaigns or elections.
While the Rolling Stone article attempts to use election integrity as a fresh topic for the stale mainstream media “Biden=Good / Trump=Bad” narrative, the reality is that the challenges and controversies surrounding the 2020 election reflect deeper issues within the U.S. electoral system that require careful examination and reform. Dismissing legitimate concerns about election integrity does a disservice to our electoral process and undermines the foundation of American government. But, then perhaps that’s the goal...

## _**Scan. Check. Protect.**_**Success!**
**Thank you to everyone who has been sharing**[ _**Scan.Check.Protect.**_](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6VDKmqL7dnq-Z_xN8QkhdZKgsxsq4umEAocVLBID6l-zNtT8Cdg3GPakOs5Hew5FuYwKbxgNdhoBvt_chMlwvSKCxEaOX0ckgpTb-r1rCfsZ5eOTo2j02Qxe371bqhzfqJZqtNxHouDId3LAawZMQ4QTTexKhHjtivCeTamhH302Mtuu9_eKhfl4mDxAXp8zOk473HmDcoNXV4bJkP7oCnvLaYnknCk-I8CbqTczKnB6/45f/KMlxBURxQSqPWFPTRCfQTA/h7/h001.p4ncC99vSzfhuQd2BaLcLv79grlimAWzmET_3udw6-s)_****_**with your family, friends and neighbors! You are making a difference! Here’s a little bit of the feedback we have gotten from the field!**
_“Using your site I was able to determine that we were still registered to vote in IL, despite having moved from there 7 years ago. From there, I was able to obtain the St Clair County IL voter registration website. Here 's the cool part, on their website was a section titled: St Clair County IL, Voter Integrity Hotline. It had both an email hot link and a telephone number to call. I called the phone number and on the second ring a real person answered. She confirmed we were still registered to vote, but listed in an "inactive/suspended" status. In IL this meant we could not vote in local elections BUT, since this year was a Presidential election, they would be sending absent voter ballots out to even this category of registered voters! When I explained we had moved 7 years ago, the very helpful lady I was talking with, Laura, based on the phone call, immediately moved us to "canceled" status which meant they would not be sending any absent voting ballots to our prior address. I share this with you that you may use this as an example to others. This whole process took less than 30 mins, produced immediate results and no additional paperwork or lengthy review/validation process at the state level was required. Kudos to Laura, who was so helpful and Thankful that we called in to clear this discrepancy up. I know IL has a reputation for voting "irregularities (fraud)" ...but in this County it appears there is a genuine focus on improving Voter Integrity. _
_Thxs for bringing this issue to our attention and initiative on how to fix this voter integrity/registration problem._
_Please feel free to share this story with others. I 'd especially recommend getting this word out to our military members who move quite often and like us, never thought about still being on another state's voter roles, years after from when we leave. Getting this QR scan code out to the military community might be very beneficial. _
_Bottom line: We found that the problem is real if you 've lived in other states, and it's not hard to fix it, especially with helpful people like Laura in St Clair County IL! There's now two less chances for voter fraud in the state of IL and maybe this doesn't seem like a lot....but, when you have a big pile of dirt to move, ever shovel full matters!”_
_**\- ”Fisher Four”**_
_“Listening to this past Monday night onward podcast with you all, I heard your scan...protect comments: yes, I am registered and do actively vote. However, wanted to focus on the "protect" aspect._
_Just coincidentally, this past Monday (29th) I got this notion to call two States that I formerly lived in: Stanislaus county (Modesto) in 1988-90, calling the board of elections, it was verified that I was not active on the voter roll; had been removed. The person I spoke with commented that "we like these kinds of calls." Second State, Hamilton county board of elections in Cincinnati, Ohio. The person I spoke with said that I was now cleared off their rolls. Glad I called. It did feel good that I could do my part, and that it just took a couple of googled phone calls.”_
* _**Greg S., Tucson**_

Throughout the article, the writers wring their hands over the adequacy of the measures taken by the Biden campaign to counteract Donald Trump's influence on election integrity. However, the portrayal oversimplifies and grossly misrepresents the multifaceted efforts aimed at ensuring the security and fairness of American electoral processes. Trump’s engagement with the electoral system over the years, misrepresented by Rolling Stone as being undermining, has actually led to heightened scrutiny and improvements in election security and integrity. Data cited in the article from the U.S. Election Assistance Commission indicates that roughly 28 million mail-in ballots have disappeared over the course of a decade. This underscores not a critique of Trump's approach, but rather illustrates one of the many systemic vulnerabilities that the Trump administration sought to address. President Trump’s efforts ranged from establishing a Commission on Voter Fraud to the enactment of Executive Order 13800 aimed at bolstering cybersecurity, reflecting a comprehensive strategy to safeguard electoral processes from interference and fraud. Rolling Stone’s narrative that Trump’s post-2020 election actions were solely designed to delegitimize Biden’s presidency overlooks the pre-existing legal challenges initiated by his campaign against states over election management issues. These challenges were rooted in concerns over election integrity, particularly around mail-in ballots and voter verification processes. Highlighting specific cases where Trump's legal team secured victories underscores the substance behind some of their claims, challenging the broad-stroke dismissal of these efforts as baseless or nefarious. The portrayal of Trump’s response to the 2020 election outcome, especially the legal battles that ensued, fails to acknowledge the nuanced context in which these actions were taken. While numerous lawsuits were dismissed, the reasons for dismissal and the nature of the allegations brought forth speak to deeper, systemic issues within the U.S. electoral framework that merit serious consideration, regardless of partisan affiliation. The article's discussion of the January 6th events and subsequent politicization offers another dimension where the narrative diverges from a comprehensive understanding of the events. By examining a broader array of sources and accounts, such as the documentary "J6: A True Timeline," a more complex picture emerges, one that challenges the cynical, partisan portrayal of Trump as the instigator. The examination of Trump’s calls for peace and order during the events at the capitol, juxtaposed against the actions and treatment of certain individuals in the media, politicians, and our judicial system, only further exposed existing biases. Of course, none of this was taken into account by Rolling Stone. The framing of Trump’s pre-election comments about the 2020 election integrity and the DNC's strategies for voter mobilization and litigation against Trump paints a picture of a deeply polarized political landscape, where actions and intentions are often interpreted through a lens of partisan bias. The emphasis on voter mobilization efforts by the DNC, while critiqued as focusing on demographic advantages rather than electoral integrity, points to broader issues of trust and confidence in the electoral system that transcend individual campaigns or elections. While the Rolling Stone article attempts to use election integrity as a fresh topic for the stale mainstream media “Biden=Good / Trump=Bad” narrative, the reality is that the challenges and controversies surrounding the 2020 election reflect deeper issues within the U.S. electoral system that require careful examination and reform. Dismissing legitimate concerns about election integrity does a disservice to our electoral process and undermines the foundation of American government. But, then perhaps that’s the goal... | Scan. Check. Protect.Success! Thank you to everyone who has been sharing your family, friends and neighbors! You are making a difference! Here’s a little bit of the feedback we have gotten from the field! “Using your site I was able to determine that we were still registered to vote in IL, despite having moved from there 7 years ago. From there, I was able to obtain the St Clair County IL voter registration website. Here 's the cool part, on their website was a section titled: St Clair County IL, Voter Integrity Hotline. It had both an email hot link and a telephone number to call. I called the phone number and on the second ring a real person answered. She confirmed we were still registered to vote, but listed in an "inactive/suspended" status. In IL this meant we could not vote in local elections BUT, since this year was a Presidential election, they would be sending absent voter ballots out to even this category of registered voters! When I explained we had moved 7 years ago, the very helpful lady I was talking with, Laura, based on the phone call, immediately moved us to "canceled" status which meant they would not be sending any absent voting ballots to our prior address. I share this with you that you may use this as an example to others. This whole process took less than 30 mins, produced immediate results and no additional paperwork or lengthy review/validation process at the state level was required. Kudos to Laura, who was so helpful and Thankful that we called in to clear this discrepancy up. I know IL has a reputation for voting "irregularities (fraud)" ...but in this County it appears there is a genuine focus on improving Voter Integrity. Thxs for bringing this issue to our attention and initiative on how to fix this voter integrity/registration problem. Please feel free to share this story with others. I 'd especially recommend getting this word out to our military members who move quite often and like us, never thought about still being on another state's voter roles, years after from when we leave. Getting this QR scan code out to the military community might be very beneficial. Bottom line: We found that the problem is real if you 've lived in other states, and it's not hard to fix it, especially with helpful people like Laura in St Clair County IL! There's now two less chances for voter fraud in the state of IL and maybe this doesn't seem like a lot....but, when you have a big pile of dirt to move, ever shovel full matters!” \- ”Fisher Four” “Listening to this past Monday night onward podcast with you all, I heard your scan...protect comments: yes, I am registered and do actively vote. However, wanted to focus on the "protect" aspect. Just coincidentally, this past Monday (29th) I got this notion to call two States that I formerly lived in: Stanislaus county (Modesto) in 1988-90, calling the board of elections, it was verified that I was not active on the voter roll; had been removed. The person I spoke with commented that "we like these kinds of calls." Second State, Hamilton county board of elections in Cincinnati, Ohio. The person I spoke with said that I was now cleared off their rolls. Glad I called. It did feel good that I could do my part, and that it just took a couple of googled phone calls.” Greg S., Tucson | | Also, check out the in a store put together for us by Rise Attire! Super fun! | We’ll be back next week with more news and updates. Until then.... Ever onward- The True the Vote Team PS - as always, even though we don’t like to ask, if you can a financial contribution, please do! Earlier this week, the Arizona Supreme Court upheld an 1864 law that bans almost all abortions in the state.

This is effectively an end to legal abortion in Arizona.

_Horrified doesn't begin to cover how I feel._

This law was passed in 1864 — before Arizona was a state and before women could vote or own property.

Now, this law will insert politicians into the most intimate decisions a person can make about their body. It will take away rights and freedoms that _generations_ of Arizona women have fought for. **And it will mandate prison time for anyone who helps a person get an abortion, which could include friends and family as well as medical professionals.**

When Donald Trump and my opponent, Juan Ciscomani, say abortion should be left up to the states, _this_ is what they mean. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82848034/466478539/389364130?refcode=WTEFHP22_20240411_EngelSplit_ND_v1s2&sourceid=1053431&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWI2YzQ0OS0zMWY4LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OWWLJGIEx5M10s-qvt2o7V0QBuwUzbCJZa6Od0PpG7E=)

But I can't do that without defeating Juan Ciscomani, who has voted again and again to restrict abortion access.** This is one of the most competitive seats in the whole country and one of the best chances we have to take back control of the House.

clean_body: Split a donation between my campaign and EMILYs List >> | = Peter, Earlier this week, the Arizona Supreme Court upheld an 1864 law that bans almost all abortions in the state. This is effectively an end to legal abortion in Arizona. Horrified doesn't begin to cover how I feel. This law was passed in 1864 — before Arizona was a state and before women could vote or own property. Now, this law will insert politicians into the most intimate decisions a person can make about their body. It will take away rights and freedoms that generations of Arizona women have fought for. And it will mandate prison time for anyone who helps a person get an abortion, which could include friends and family as well as medical professionals. When Donald Trump and my opponent, Juan Ciscomani, say abortion should be left up to the states, this is what they mean. = Unlike my opponent, I'm unapologetically pro-choice, which is why I'm proud to have earned the endorsements of EMILYs List, Planned Parenthood, and Reproductive Freedom for All. In Congress, I will fight to codify Roe v. Wade into law. But I can't do that without defeating Juan Ciscomani, who has voted again and again to restrict abortion access. Peter, Millions of Americans had a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity this week to gather and watch a full solar eclipse. Recognizing the educational opportunity to witness science and mathematics in real-time, many schools closed for the day or let students out early so they could watch the eclipse with their families.
In a time when so many people with big megaphones look to divide us, this was a special moment for unity and reflection. For me, the reflection was about the wondrous nature of God's creation, and how vital it is that we all regulate our own humility with things that are larger than ourselves.

I was in Iowa last week to speak at an event hosted by the Carrie Chapman Catt Center for Women and Politics. One of the topics I spoke about there was the importance for leaders, especially those in the tech space, to have humility as they create the technologies of the future. While we're on the topic of things that should bring us unity and positivity, I should mention that I spoke earlier this week about how important it is that we recognize the patriotic contributions of the election workers in America's states and territories. [You can watch my remarks (here)](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=9ddf854e2b10457a91d2d1d342d2dd84&_e=nTpkvxKAlj9V7u727XeuqU4WZ3BsiLh_cSYyWb4iwLr7lTEAeDFfRc31l8mqGvfEqcovLifW0UoTwb4vHWss-ePv_VZdRMtORwPZsRVmSCLu0peu_g0eSRzaIdXmJn0OTSDCrZtmTaiv88XfOkvBUN3b-Ann-mlcXXSl7XEZLX0fp_KtotPYZiHN3J4wP3eiR34ijMEnsMtuxadplzwO4yVrSGzwTD3YEOtAPxRQt2M%3D).

These folks, with extremely few exceptions, are passionate about our democracy and work hard to make sure that voting is accessible and secure. Even in those very rare instances of voter irregularities, they're almost always an understandable mistake where someone got confused about the process and had no intention of breaking any laws.
But if you listen to the naysayers and people who want to divide us, they make it sound like there is widespread fraud happening in our elections. In reality, it's exceedingly rare and Americans should have complete confidence in the way that elections are managed.

Our democracy is being tested right now, but it's stronger than many give it credit for being. It will be a long time before Americans gather again for a full solar eclipse. We need to seek out many and more frequent opportunities to come together rather than looking for opportunities to attack one another. Otherwise, how is constant bitterness and backbiting really serving us and helping ensure that we leave a stronger country for our children?

clean_body: Millions of Americans had a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity this week to gather and watch a full solar eclipse.| | | Peter, Millions of Americans had a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity this week to gather and watch a full solar eclipse. Recognizing the educational opportunity to witness science and mathematics in real-time, many schools closed for the day or let students out early so they could watch the eclipse with their families. In a time when so many people with big megaphones look to divide us, this was a special moment for unity and reflection. For me, the reflection was about the wondrous nature of God's creation, and how vital it is that we all regulate our own humility with things that are larger than ourselves. I was in Iowa last week to speak at an event hosted by the Carrie Chapman Catt Center for Women and Politics. One of the topics I spoke about there was the importance for leaders, especially those in the tech space, to have humility as they create the technologies of the future. . Photo Credit: Brielle Tuttle, Iowa State Daily While we're on the topic of things that should bring us unity and positivity, I should mention that I spoke earlier this week about how important it is that we recognize the patriotic contributions of the election workers in America's states and territories. . These folks, with extremely few exceptions, are passionate about our democracy and work hard to make sure that voting is accessible and secure. Even in those very rare instances of voter irregularities, they're almost always an understandable mistake where someone got confused about the process and had no intention of breaking any laws. But if you listen to the naysayers and people who want to divide us, they make it sound like there is widespread fraud happening in our elections. In reality, it's exceedingly rare and Americans should have complete confidence in the way that elections are managed. Our democracy is being tested right now, but it's stronger than many give it credit for being. It will be a long time before Americans gather again for a full solar eclipse. We need to seek out many and more frequent opportunities to come together rather than looking for opportunities to attack one another. Otherwise, how is constant bitterness and backbiting really serving us and helping ensure that we leave a stronger country for our children? | I'm out there every week giving speeches, doing media interviews, communicating on social media and using every other tool at my disposal to give hope and encouragement to as many Americans as I can. . Will you please consider chipping in right now to help with this important cause and ensure that we can keep up the fight for a better America? I'm so appreciative for your ongoing support. Friend,

America is clearly on the wrong track – over two-thirds of Americans agree, _and you’re likely one of them._

Less than 40% approve of the job Joe Biden is doing, and there’s no arguing that he and Martin Heinrich have let us down.

But it’s more than that – together, they’ve pushed policies that are actively harming Americans; from our families, to our jobs, to our safety, to our freedoms.

We’re on the wrong track, and we can and MUST do better. **That’s why I’m running to be the next Republican U.S. Senator from New Mexico,[and why I’m asking for your support.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=bb62a1b7974344bea696dcf358ea9119&_e=V0oSnvlG6fWPUKRdIiR0wyx6UoI33q9dEQviP52PWzkPxBGyjUE91_f1K_-iMp7LOimBKlc395a-Ns_wzGyBtBmP8iI7oIJ8qg3DWvYg74QXjnmW1UAoMS0WpGbYYAX421eUgLyw-CqY_5gzqrY_lWakQgWOEhTVHsWgiTl89laJxYreWDIoBcuQuSMcmzE-dpjYPuYRL3Dn3bXjV6hkyXa1wivOvCVbBxvdzNo0SALZXjREf-EhgXO4UCQj1yEsDTjhbTYfC8DZEe1gPmgLre0PrKAX6IA5zs-fOuZiWHrAP7bsEKmJSZrSAym4_r5frkKb5FZ58ZkZucKFNs2Id2bH8GaiAjLASaL4UeFAtg72htXfHBSLMwNAQEqUeHctmT-sid92o-mjh818f5B7fg%3D%3D)**

[ ** JOIN NELLA » **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=bb62a1b7974344bea696dcf358ea9119&_e=V0oSnvlG6fWPUKRdIiR0wyx6UoI33q9dEQviP52PWzkPxBGyjUE91_f1K_-iMp7LOimBKlc395a-Ns_wzGyBtBmP8iI7oIJ8qg3DWvYg74QXjnmW1UAoMS0WpGbYYAX421eUgLyw-CqY_5gzqrY_lWakQgWOEhTVHsWgiTl89laJxYreWDIoBcuQuSMcmzE-dpjYPuYRL3Dn3bXjV6hkyXa1wivOvCVbBxvdzNo0SALZXjREf-EhgXO4UCQj1yEsfzxhn2_iRuvuh8ey0WwkXnTwGq2j-LW12QozaNNpKi4P1gnjOzRolosbzj12NzToct_pXpgwd9_jqBHavspr3PK4znvKUn6v7FJDZFtoOpjL99wBf6tlUq4jvjQ3jVcsKYxfiLrfonxp9WYrlwqYYw%3D%3D)
These are SOME of New Mexico’s issues that are national issues that I will fight for when I reach the Senate:

* **Securing the border** , stopping the flow of fentanyl and human trafficking
* **Lowering costs** for hardworking Americans and unleashing American domestic energy
* **Making neighborhoods safe** for our families and supporting the police
* **Improving education** through choice and competition
* Destigmatizing and finally **addressing mental illness**

But to get these things done, we need a Republican-controlled Senate so we have a majority that actually cares about these things.

body:
As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump

| |
---
| |
---
Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I’m asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkMGq4yAYhZ_G7Az6a4xdZHEvSe7mppROYZai8U8raBqMYV5_aJnZ3-3H4XC-83sykw0xrPezTdiVXEzejfMmYvQLzbgWGw0wkJRJyrkRle9kC16oCjvectCq1QDVo-MeVOsBF2SsERwdOi3lCaRolBKOV6F79TDJOT9xYE2NTMwLY07YRaPXDZHMRsxlr8sDM26Hi2G2a0Gb6vmZqtg9Stl2Ij4IjATGHecjY21X9M_yShAY37sJjMA0a2BxdAa5UNksijrRNtS2qIFp7oQ6ETEeJZn9eeQZieg_-y96Hc4E1Asn9OFIRPTD9I_MNm023Fci-v8m5rP_Mt_Ddz-aX1N_uZjrcDaXD3q73qrc-e1PiDHsqiWS3ZMN8e1RfvLz3wAAAP__fE59jg)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck – and involved the department’s helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home – and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage.When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.)No doubt Eric saved his partner’s life that afternoon – and probably his own.**But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench.** Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric’s case – exhausting his options through the justice system._Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!_**A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric’s last remaining options for freedom.****[Now you know why I’m asking you to follow this link to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right away.](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkMGq4yAYhZ_G7Az6a4xdZHEvSe7mppROYZai8U8raBqMYV5_aJnZ3-3H4XC-83sykw0xrPezTdiVXEzejfMmYvQLzbgWGw0wkJRJyrkRle9kC16oCjvectCq1QDVo-MeVOsBF2SsERwdOi3lCaRolBKOV6F79TDJOT9xYE2NTMwLY07YRaPXDZHMRsxlr8sDM26Hi2G2a0Gb6vmZqtg9Stl2Ij4IjATGHecjY21X9M_yShAY37sJjMA0a2BxdAa5UNksijrRNtS2qIFp7oQ6ETEeJZn9eeQZieg_-y96Hc4E1Asn9OFIRPTD9I_MNm023Fci-v8m5rP_Mt_Ddz-aX1N_uZjrcDaXD3q73qrc-e1PiDHsqiWS3ZMN8e1RfvLz3wAAAP__fE59jg)** My name is Stephanie Mohr and I’m proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund – a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom.I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George’s County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book – including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect’s civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials – in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me – I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones – not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense – but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name.That’s why I can’t turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. **And I hope you won’t either.** **[**Will you sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Missouri Governor Mike Parson right away?**](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkMGq4yAYhZ_G7Az6a4xdZHEvSe7mppROYZai8U8raBqMYV5_aJnZ3-3H4XC-83sykw0xrPezTdiVXEzejfMmYvQLzbgWGw0wkJRJyrkRle9kC16oCjvectCq1QDVo-MeVOsBF2SsERwdOi3lCaRolBKOV6F79TDJOT9xYE2NTMwLY07YRaPXDZHMRsxlr8sDM26Hi2G2a0Gb6vmZqtg9Stl2Ij4IjATGHecjY21X9M_yShAY37sJjMA0a2BxdAa5UNksijrRNtS2qIFp7oQ6ETEeJZn9eeQZieg_-y96Hc4E1Asn9OFIRPTD9I_MNm023Fci-v8m5rP_Mt_Ddz-aX1N_uZjrcDaXD3q73qrc-e1PiDHsqiWS3ZMN8e1RfvLz3wAAAP__fE59jg)** Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! The reality is we can’t get back the last several months Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has been hanging over his head.But with your help today, we can bring Eric home to his wife and three children. **[So please, won’t you take just 30 seconds of your time right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Governor Mike Parson?](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkMGq4yAYhZ_G7Az6a4xdZHEvSe7mppROYZai8U8raBqMYV5_aJnZ3-3H4XC-83sykw0xrPezTdiVXEzejfMmYvQLzbgWGw0wkJRJyrkRle9kC16oCjvectCq1QDVo-MeVOsBF2SsERwdOi3lCaRolBKOV6F79TDJOT9xYE2NTMwLY07YRaPXDZHMRsxlr8sDM26Hi2G2a0Gb6vmZqtg9Stl2Ij4IjATGHecjY21X9M_yShAY37sJjMA0a2BxdAa5UNksijrRNtS2qIFp7oQ6ETEeJZn9eeQZieg_-y96Hc4E1Asn9OFIRPTD9I_MNm023Fci-v8m5rP_Mt_Ddz-aX1N_uZjrcDaXD3q73qrc-e1PiDHsqiWS3ZMN8e1RfvLz3wAAAP__fE59jg)** After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of eight officers (including Eric) they currently support.Remember, LELDF is able to support wrongly accused and convicted officers like Eric and me because of the generosity of patriots like you. And with a pardon the final option to secure Eric’s freedom and restore his good name, I’m begging you to [**sign the Emergency Pardon Petition today**.](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkMGq4yAYhZ_G7Az6a4xdZHEvSe7mppROYZai8U8raBqMYV5_aJnZ3-3H4XC-83sykw0xrPezTdiVXEzejfMmYvQLzbgWGw0wkJRJyrkRle9kC16oCjvectCq1QDVo-MeVOsBF2SsERwdOi3lCaRolBKOV6F79TDJOT9xYE2NTMwLY07YRaPXDZHMRsxlr8sDM26Hi2G2a0Gb6vmZqtg9Stl2Ij4IjATGHecjY21X9M_yShAY37sJjMA0a2BxdAa5UNksijrRNtS2qIFp7oQ6ETEeJZn9eeQZieg_-y96Hc4E1Asn9OFIRPTD9I_MNm023Fci-v8m5rP_Mt_Ddz-aX1N_uZjrcDaXD3q73qrc-e1PiDHsqiWS3ZMN8e1RfvLz3wAAAP__fE59jg)Thank you in advance for your support.

Stephanie MohrDirector, Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund P.S. Without your immediate action, Eric DeValkenaere – a decorated Kansas City Police Detective – will spend the next six years behind bars. His three beautiful children won’t have their biggest cheerleader at their graduations, maybe even their weddings. And the only way to get him out is to get Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon him. **[Will you please take 30 seconds right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition and help me fight for Eric’s freedom?](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkMGq4yAYhZ_G7Az6a4xdZHEvSe7mppROYZai8U8raBqMYV5_aJnZ3-3H4XC-83sykw0xrPezTdiVXEzejfMmYvQLzbgWGw0wkJRJyrkRle9kC16oCjvectCq1QDVo-MeVOsBF2SsERwdOi3lCaRolBKOV6F79TDJOT9xYE2NTMwLY07YRaPXDZHMRsxlr8sDM26Hi2G2a0Gb6vmZqtg9Stl2Ij4IjATGHecjY21X9M_yShAY37sJjMA0a2BxdAa5UNksijrRNtS2qIFp7oQ6ETEeJZn9eeQZieg_-y96Hc4E1Asn9OFIRPTD9I_MNm023Fci-v8m5rP_Mt_Ddz-aX1N_uZjrcDaXD3q73qrc-e1PiDHsqiWS3ZMN8e1RfvLz3wAAAP__fE59jg)** I hope you’ll also make a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF. clean_body: As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump | | | | Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I’m asking you to sign this because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck – and involved the department’s helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home – and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage.When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.)No doubt Eric saved his partner’s life that afternoon – and probably his own.But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench. Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric’s case – exhausting his options through the justice system.Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric’s last remaining options for freedom. My name is Stephanie Mohr and I’m proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund – a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom.I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George’s County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book – including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect’s civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials – in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me – I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones – not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense – but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name.That’s why I can’t turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. And I hope you won’t either. Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! The reality is we can’t get back the last several months Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has been hanging over his head.But with your help today, we can bring Eric home to his wife and three children. After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of eight officers (including Eric) they currently support.Remember, LELDF is able to support wrongly accused and convicted officers like Eric and me because of the generosity of patriots like you. And with a pardon the final option to secure Eric’s freedom and restore his good name, I’m begging you to you in advance for your support. | | Gratefully, Stephanie MohrDirector, Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund P.S. Without your immediate action, Eric DeValkenaere – a decorated Kansas City Police Detective – will spend the next six years behind bars. His three beautiful children won’t have their biggest cheerleader at their graduations, maybe even their weddings. And the only way to get him out is to get Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon him. I hope you’ll also make a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF. No matter what, please pray for Eric and his heartbroken family. | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember - Blue Lives Matter! | | | ---|---|--- © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | 2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303 | The Republican Team PO Box 2221 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

Here’s the deal, Peter: Right-wing super PACs are already dumping millions of dollars into this race to flip PA red, and my opponent just launched a seven-figure ad buy of his own.

With the Senate majority hinging on PA, getting our ads on the air is critical to fighting back and sharing my message with Pennsylvanians – but ads are expensive, so we need to step up our fundraising to keep them running.

**Friend, is there anything I can say to convince you to** [**split $10 between my campaign and Fight for Reform**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/41778?t=7&akid=21218%2E4449941%2EXIQwoj) **before my midnight deadline?** Would it make any difference if I shared that, with Senate control hinging on my race in Ohio, we're officially _losing ground_ in the latest polls?

What if I told you my GOP opponent is a self-funding millionaire ready to do whatever it takes to buy this seat and flip the Senate red – and he just raised nearly $350,000 at a massive Mar‐a‐Lago fundraiser?

And what if I told you that Mitch McConnell-aligned super PACs just made their largest ad reservation in one state _ever_ to turn the tides against me?

# Disability Advocacy
---
Pennsylvania’s insultingly low minimum wage is not a living wage. Did you know that right now, if you have a disability in America, it is legal to pay you BELOW the minimum wage? Want to get married? [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=apr2024_abs_em.I2BRAI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20240411_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1004&akid=6208%2E5257348%2EY67BaW ]Derek —
Today, I’m asking you to pitch in just
$10 to my
campaign for the U.S. Senate, ahead of our upcoming mid-month deadline.
I’ll explain why in a moment.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=apr2024_abs_em.I2BRAI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20240411_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1005&akid=6208%2E5257348%2EY67BaW ]DONATE
$10

I recently read this article in the New York Times:

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| The Very Rich G.O.P. Senate Candidates Bidding for Working-Class Votes |
| |
|“The intentional decision by Republicans in Washington, D.C., to get |
|behind candidates with enormous personal fortunes will most likely give |
|the party a boost as it struggles for campaign cash against the |
|Democrats’ formidable grass-roots fund-raising operations. But the sheer|
|affluence of the candidates — and how they made their money — is sure to|
|be a factor in the fight for Senate control.” |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Derek,
while Republicans have struggled to build grassroots support for their
campaigns, they’ve turned to ultra-wealthy, far-right celebrity candidates
to run for office — including Steve Garvey right here in California.

Mitch McConnell and the Senate Republicans’ campaign arm have successfully
recruited candidates in Montana, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin who can
spend millions of their own money on their campaigns. Not to mention the
flood of super PAC dollars from Mitch McConnell’s GOP dark-money donors.

For McConnell and Trump, that’s good news. More than 200,000 of Trump’s
2020 donors have abandoned his campaign, and he’s relying on wealthy
self-funders to pick up the slack as he diverts his donors’ money to his
mounting legal bills.

For years, I have worked hard to reform our campaign finance system, and
together we’ve built this campaign without a penny of corporate PAC money.
Derek,
it’s not just about talking the talk — to reform our corrupt campaign
finance system, we need to walk the walk.

I introduced the landmark constitutional amendment to overturn the
Citizens United Supreme Court decision, allow reasonable restrictions on
political spending, outlaw dark money, and allow public financing of
campaigns.

But while our campaign finance system is stacked against voters in favor
of the ultra-rich and the mega-corporations that can cut big checks, I’m
counting on this grassroots team to support my campaign and Democrats
nationwide.

I’ve seen the power of our work before.

We’ve won tough races that pundits thought were unwinnable because of the
strength of this grassroots team. Think of Senators Raphael Warnock in
Georgia and Catherine Cortez Masto in Nevada. Or Representatives Mike
Levin and Josh Harder in California, who won tough re-elections and kept
the GOP’s majority slim.

In the November elections, it won’t be easy to defend the Senate majority,
flip the House, and protect the White House, especially up against so many
wealthy Republican candidates. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=apr2024_abs_em.I2BRAI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20240411_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1006&akid=6208%2E5257348%2EY67BaW ]But if everyone reading this message
pitched in just
$10, it
would go a long way in standing up to the GOP.
Derek,
will you chip in
$10 today?

| | | Team, I am incredibly disappointed.

Earlier this week, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.

**No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.**

As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.

It was a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.

We must do everything we can to make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land again.

I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

subject: Adam Schiff Throws His Support Behind Dave Min, Citing the High Stakes of California's 47th Congressional District Race
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/64f4cf978c54/adam-schiff-throws-his-support-behind-dave-min-citing-the-high-stakes-of-californias-47th-congressional-district-race-15673215?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** April 11, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Adam Schiff Throws His Support Behind Dave Min, Citing the High Stakes of California's 47th Congressional District Race**
**IRVINE, CA** — Today, Congressman Adam Schiff announced he is endorsing Dave Min for California’s 47th Congressional District, providing yet another jolt of momentum for Min in one of the nation’s most-watched congressional races. Schiff’s endorsement, coming from one of the most prominent and respected figures in the Democratic Party, highlights the critical importance of this race, not just for California but for control of the House of Representatives.

**“As we face one of the most consequential elections in our history, the choice for California’s 47th could not be clearer,”** said Congressman Adam Schiff. **“From his time prosecuting corporate fraud at the SEC to his tenure in the California State Senate, Dave Min has been committed to the principles of justice, equality, and the protection of our planet. His dedication to the well-being of his constituents and his vision of a more inclusive and prosperous future are exactly what we need in Congress at this critical moment.”**

Dave Min, whose career has been defined by his commitment to public service and his advocacy for progressive values, has emerged as a leading voice for change in one of the country’s most closely contested districts. With a track record of legislative achievements in the California State Senate, Min has been at the forefront of efforts to combat climate change, ensure reproductive rights, promote gun safety, and fight for economic justice

**“To have the support of Congressman Adam Schiff, a true champion for our democracy and someone who has tirelessly worked to hold those in power accountable, is incredibly humbling,”** said Min.**“This race is about more than just one district; it’s about the future direction of our country. I am committed to fighting for the American Dream, a dream that promises equality, opportunity, and justice for all, and I am ready to bring this fight to Washington.”**

In his role as a California State Senator, Dave has proven himself as a forward-thinking legislator, actively addressing key issues with practical solutions. His legislative efforts to halt offshore drilling and advocate for the decarbonization of key industries, alongside his push for corporate accountability in environmental impact, have positioned him as a key player in the environmental advocacy arena. Beyond these accomplishments, Dave's dedication to the principles of justice, his proactive efforts to combat voter suppression, and his push for an education system that evolves with our economic landscape further highlight his aptitude and eagerness to confront some of the most pressing issues our society faces today with both grounded and creative solutions.

A Harvard Law School graduate, Min's career has been defined by his choice to combat corporate fraud at the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) following significant accounting scandals, rather than pursuing more lucrative private sector opportunities. His advocacy for economic fairness continued on Capitol Hill as an economic policy director, particularly during the mortgage crisis, further solidifying his commitment to justice and equity. Min's commitment to economic equity and justice continued as he served as an economic policy director on Capitol Hill, notably during the critical times of the mortgage crisis, before returning to California to contribute to the academic foundation of UC Irvine's then-new law school.

Dave Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, as well as the California Democratic Party, Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, California Environmental Voters, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=57e1a5b6d4&e=7017cc100e). ### _California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

body:
| American Patriot,

**_I 'm getting nervous._**

Despite my attempts to reach out to you time and time again, you have yet to respond to any of my messages.

It's especially concerning to me that you're the _only Republican_ in your area who's not engaging with your email.

**_Are you abandoning hope?_**

Please, don't give up so soon. The fight's not over until we lose grassroots support from voters like you.

So, I'll leave you with this challenging question: _Where do your priorities lie?_

Take a look at what I sent you last week, **[and consider making a difference for conservative campaigns in danger of collapse.](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=1c6443cb4d8b46208befc81ada85a98f&_e=GgkIvKlUXnuIoYlbFtbM-jk-HEQXRv3WWBVSTp4umTJqYzIfxKRJTupXrLNWX_UTOv8WdrxSHqcP464tNHkPvHEB7qVqQU_Ab-pho8sy_fapHpFK_NkzOLRf-umjJDHVnhq-oveRRL-Ge03QHtnJ6NJIZGgGJJnuWbZuqOY6b8qXjje5C9GY_HwA1jy3RB1MQ7OBAmZrzwUB4JZeMa_SyHs3MLq8zc2DrYyhFJRrS7OcgYnACxzZDlnQnkkVA2IWIXNuM7j6l7SUMWZJcNTK92fdN7qW5PDx5twHuCaKl-rwDBWVNGBuIIvYomn8_fnN)**

\- Jim Banks

--\- Begin forwarded message --\-

_Fellow Patriots, I'm afraid I have BAD news._

_Before I reach out to**Trump** and **J.D. Vance,** can you step in?_

_Here's the situation: Yesterday was my first major fundraising deadline, and my finance team just broke the news to me:**we were 19 donations short.**_

_This would have been a huge blow, but we've found a way to extend the deadline by 24 hours through**[this special donation link.](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=1c6443cb4d8b46208befc81ada85a98f&_e=GgkIvKlUXnuIoYlbFtbM-jk-HEQXRv3WWBVSTp4umTJqYzIfxKRJTupXrLNWX_UTOv8WdrxSHqcP464tNHkPvHEB7qVqQU_Ab-pho8sy_fapHpFK_NkzOLRf-umjJDHVnhq-oveRRL-Ge03QHtnJ6NJIZGgGJJnuWbZuqOY6b8owL1Z2FB3xCqeYp2qWgyLH6zxxK4EHqv6HaZ9ZfuikBevfh24I6hw_T6LM1nQhMpz8wcxys2WoGZqr8m8dfqelPYymJZfNvqrhORkOZL5HL0Gji3u_MBrMMrSeGLWCxLJlnFJ9fwwgboKMaOVAT8Zh)**_

_While it's impossible to add anything more to my federally mandated report...we have one more chance to make our internal goal and get back on track._

_So, as a personal favor to me -- will you stop what you're doing and make a special, one-time donation? Even if it's **only $5 ...** it will be the difference between completing our mission and surrendering._

It’s Zoey and Koko, the CongressDogs, pawing our way into your inbox to spread some furry love on National Pet Day! As the proud four-legged companions of Susan Wild, we’ve had the unique privilege of witnessing the ins and outs of politics firsthand. From tagging along on the campaign trail to hanging out on Capitol Hill (no big woof), we've been there through it all! But today, we’re not here to bark on about ourselves (though we are pretty cute!). Instead, we’re wagging our tails with excitement to ask for your support. She's a dedicated public servant who works tirelessly to represent all of our friends and neighbors, both human and furry alike. body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| |
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Hello, This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, April 11, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Colorado voters may get final say over the legislature side-stepping open meetings**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
* Jon Caldara, president of the Independence Institute, and Vanessa Rutledge presented [Initiative 287](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) before the Legislative Council staff, [seeking to repeal Senate Bill 157](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* [SB 157](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), signed into law by Gov. Polis, allowed state legislators to meet in small groups [without public oversight](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), exempting them from Colorado's sunshine law. Caldara's initiative aims to remove this exemption and restore transparency to legislative meetings.

* The initiative faces hurdles regarding the [single-subject rule for ballot proposals](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), but Caldara argues it simply aims to repeal the law. Caldara must gather over 125,000 signatures of registered voters to get the initiative on the ballot, a task made potentially easier by [widespread opposition to SB 157](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from media outlets and government watchdog organizations.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**Hurd qualifies for primary ballot in Colorado’s 3rd District U.S. House race**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* [Jeff Hurd](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a Grand Junction attorney, has successfully secured a place on the ballot for Colorado's 3rd Congressional District. Despite some rejected signatures, Hurd's petition [met the required threshold](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) with 2,162 accepted signatures out of 4,388 submitted.

* Former Secretary of State Scott Gessler and former State Treasurer Walker Stapleton have [endorsed Hurd's candidacy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* Hurd's campaign emphasizes a focus on action over personal recognition, with priorities including [border security, job creation, and support for families](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* _ICYMI: The current holder of the 3rd District seat, Rep. Lauren Boebert, has relocated and is now seeking the 4th District seat previously held by ex-Rep. Ken Buck._

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Holtorf, a Republican, and McCorkle, a Democrat, qualify for 4th District ballot**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Democrat Ike McCorkle and Republican Richard Holtorf have both qualified for the ballot in Colorado's [4th Congressional District primaries](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* McCorkle, making his third bid for the Democratic nomination, submitted 2,179 signatures, with 1,783 accepted. Holtorf, the current Colorado House minority whip seeking the Republican nomination, submitted 2,612 signatures, with 1,866 accepted.

* Both candidates[ surpassed the required threshold](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) of 1,500 accepted signatures.
Rep. Lauren Boebert and Deborah Flora have also qualified for the ballot through petitions, with Boebert additionally qualifying via delegate support at assembly. The status of ballot petitions for other candidates in the 4th District race is [pending release](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Colorado’s $40.6 Billion budget is nearing final passage. Here’s what’s in it.**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's [budget for the 2024-25 fiscal year](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), totaling $40.6 billion, is approaching final approval, emphasizing increased spending on state workers, health care services, K-12 education, and higher education.

* The budget proposal aims to address a long-standing school funding deficit stemming from the Great Recession, known as the budget stabilization factor, which has [cost schools over $9.9 billion since 2010](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* Higher education institutions are set to receive a [$132 million boost](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), allowing for limited tuition increases while prioritizing affordability for Colorado residents and slightly higher rates for out-of-state students.

* A significant portion of the budget increase is allocated to health care and social services, with the Department of Health Care Policy and Financing and the Department of Human Services receiving [substantial funding hikes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* In response to worker shortages, the budget proposes [generous pay raises](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for state workers and [signing bonuses](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to address vacancies in critical positions, particularly in corrections, mental health care, and Medicaid providers.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Speaker Mike Johnson has chance to lead on Ukraine**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY KELLY SLOAN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _House Speaker Mike Johnson is experiencing a defining moment in his career. As Congress resumes, he seems to have successfully – one hopes – hammered out a workable deal to finally get arms flowing to the Ukrainians as their defense starts to falter._ _Effective support for Ukraine’s defence is the central foreign policy question facing Western leaders today. There are, of course, no shortage of serious foreign policy dilemmas – one could toss a dart at a world map and chances are pretty good that wherever it lands there is some kind of trouble brewing – but it is difficult to understate the importance of Ukraine. The Israelis are tough and will likely prevail with or without American support (though how much better for our own national honour were they to be able to count on our commitment.) Iran’s relative strength is largely subsidized by Russia; and while China is arguably the bigger threat, the fate of Taiwan and the Western Pacific hinges to a great extent on how things turn out in eastern Europe._ [**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️** **[Second calf in a five-day stretch killed by wolves in Northern Colorado, CPW says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF | STATE | APRIL 10** _The second incident of a livestock kill in five days by a wolf has been confirmed by Colorado Parks and Wildlife.__Following the depredation of a calf in Grand County, another was realized in neighboring Jackson County on the morning of April 7, the CPW reports, following a field investigation._ **[Republican House whip and CD4 candidate Richard Holtorf calls upon State GOP Chair Williams to resign](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 9** _State Rep. Richard Holtorf, a candidate for Colorado’s 4th District seat in Congress, called Tuesday for Colorado Republican Party Chairman Dave Williams to resign, citing “numerous conflicts of interest” and “radical endorsement policies” alienating candidates for statewide and federal office._ [**Editorial: Trump abortion policy a turn toward state’s rights**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD | NATIONAL | APRIL 9** _The issue: President Donald Trump this week announced his abortion policy, favoring states independently deciding how to regulate abortion._ **Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. **We’ll lose the House, and truly, I don’t think we can handle a single day of total Democrat control in Washington.**

What Democrats want to do to America is clinically insane – _they want to change our foundations, to make our country unrecognizable. They are wasting all of your hard-earned money to fund illegal immigrants, higher prices, defunding the police, forcing parents out of the classroom, and lining their own pockets._

subject: Like 133 million Americans, I have a pre-existing condition

body:
| If Eric Hovde flips this seat, the ACA will be on the chopping block.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2401%2E35263%2EWAE02Q)
Peter — Do you recognize the little girl in this photo? [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240411_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2401%2E35263%2EWAE02Q) That’s me. Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket and make enormous sacrifices to do so — _all because I had a pre-existing condition._ **That’s why I got into public service.** I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. I thought no one should ever have to go through that. But I knew they weren’t the only ones. I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to our care — and before the _Affordable Care Act_ was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Now, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and wrote the amendment to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — including my Republican opponent who has said there’s no part of the ACA he supports. **If Eric Hovde flips this seat and secures the Senate majority for Republicans, the ACA will be on the chopping block and countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules.** The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I’ve fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, Peter. **[Will you make a donation to my reelection campaign to defend our Democratic Senate majority? That’s the only way we’ll prevent Republicans from rolling back the progress we’ve made expanding access to affordable health care.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240411_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=2401%2E35263%2EWAE02Q)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $5 NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3663?c0=tbe-em-apr24.Xs9pUr&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240411_AM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=2401%2E35263%2EWAE02Q)

Derek,
It has been nearly two months since the Senate passed a bill fully funding our support for Ukraine.

in Gaza and then still send more bombs to Israel, like President Biden is
doing. Bernie didn’t hesitate to make that point on Pod Save America:

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16660?t=1011&akid=5777%2E5885482%2EKBaPC7 ][IMG]

bombs to Israel. We must amplify Bernie’s calls to stop more American-made
bombs from falling in Gaza. We cannot allow more U.S. taxpayer money to
support Netanyahu’s atrocities against the Palestinian people.

loosen restrictions on humanitarian aid to Gaza. But given Israel’s

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1333%2E135344%2ERrYate)

Hey there --
If you’ve followed any of our three campaigns, you've heard me say that a key objective for us is to "lose better." That means doing just a little bit better in the Republican-leaning areas of Michigan -- losing with 44% of the vote in Holly Township rather than 39% or losing with 30% of the vote in Conway Township rather than 26%. My last election was a perfect example: We won our race by 5% -- our biggest-ever win margin -- and it was driven, in part, by our “losing better” performance in the most conservative areas of the district.
That's what we have to do to win this Senate race. Joe Biden got 43% of the vote in Bay County in 2020: can we do a little better in 2024? He got 36% of the vote in Delta County: can we do a little better in 2024?
For example, in Livingston County, a county I currently represent, Joe Biden won 37.91% of the vote in 2020. I won 40.06% of the vote in 2022. Those small margins of overperformance -- three percent here, four percent there -- in the places all across the state where we can do just a little bit better, are how we get across the finish line next November.
I am the only Democrat left in the House who has won in a district that went for Romney in 2012, Trump in 2016 and Trump again in 2020. That's because I campaign everywhere and take no vote for granted.
This is what we have to do to win this Senate race. Since we kicked off our race in last February, I have traveled to 25 counties across the state, attended hundreds of events, and met thousands of Michiganders -- talking to people directly about the issues that really matter to them and their families and going to places early in the campaign that are not thought to be traditional Democratic strongholds.
**That’s why I say: Lose better.**
But a campaign like this requires all-hands-on-deck. We have a little less than 7 months to reach as many voters as possible to keep Michigan blue, but it’s going to take all of us working together. That’s why I would love to earn your support today. name: Gallego for Arizona
subject: Lake + Abortion
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
We need your help to make sure every voter in Arizona knows that it was Trump, Lake, and the Arizona GOP who brought this abortion ban on the people of Arizona.
#

Peter -
We send a good amount of fundraising emails, and we don’t expect you to give to every one that hits your inbox. But we do hope you’ll give to this one.
Please let us explain why:
**FIRST:** Kari Lake ran a campaign in 2022 as one of the most extreme anti-abortion candidates in the entire country. She called abortion the “ultimate sin” and was absolutely ecstatic that a law passed in 1864 could force a near-complete ban on abortion.
**THEN:** The Arizona Supreme Court did it. They decided that 160 year old law, from before women could vote or even have their own bank accounts, was enforceable. Now, millions of Arizonans have lost rights that their grandmothers were born with.
**NOW:** Kari Lake is terrified. She’s claiming that she doesn’t support this ban — the same one she praised as a “great law” back in 2022 — and is pretending to be some kind of champion for choice.
**Not on our watch.**
We need your help to make sure every voter in Arizona knows that it was Trump, Lake, and the Arizona GOP who brought this abortion ban on the people of Arizona.
If everyone reading this email contributed just $10, we’d absolutely crush our fundraising goals and have more than enough to take the fight to Kari Lake.

name: John Avlon
subject: Back to 1864? Believe them.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS
body:
Friends,

At this point, all Americans should understand that reproductive freedom is under assault by right-wing extremists. But even in our dystopian, post-Dobbs era, I didn't see 1864 coming.

But that’s suddenly where Arizona is, thanks to a decision by its Supreme Court to revert all abortion policy to a 100% ban passed in the middle of the Civil War – a time when some states still had slavery and decades before women had the right to vote.

This is about as subtle as the Handmaid's Tale - but it is a reminder that we can take nothing for granted when it comes to abortion rights. Even in New York.
Remember that far-right group Rep. Nick LaLota’s part of in Congress? The one that wants to cut Medicare and Social Security? They just endorsed a national abortion ban. And they want to take it even further by banning IVF and most forms of contraception.

Make no mistake: any vote for a Republican Congressman is a vote to advance that agenda. It’s a vote for Donald Trump and making Mike Johnson Speaker again - with all their extremism, division and dysfunction.

Don’t just listen to what they say – look at what they do. After all, Trump’s Supreme Court nominees told the U.S. Senate and the American people that Roe vs. Wade was settled law, safe as a matter of precedent - and then they took the first chance they could to overturn it. When people show you who they are, believe them.

Here's the thing: the American people are far more united around basic abortion rights then the far right would have you believe. The vast majority of Americans believe that the decision to have an abortion should be between a woman, her doctor, and her God — not the government.

That’s the common sense standard I’ll stand for in congress - protecting women’s fundamental reproductive freedoms. Actions, not words. There will be no national abortion ban with a Democratic Congress. Full stop.

The road to take back the House runs through our district, but I can’t do it alone. Donate $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford to ensure our campaign has the resources it needs to win. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-emq2]

Thank you for fighting the good fight for freedom and equality alongside me.

-John
