Peter,

America is clearly on the wrong track – over two-thirds of Americans agree, _and you’re likely one of them._

Less than 40% approve of the job Joe Biden is doing, and there’s no arguing that he and Martin Heinrich have let us down.

But it’s more than that – together, they’ve pushed policies that are actively harming Americans; from our families, to our jobs, to our safety, to our freedoms.

We’re on the wrong track, and we can and MUST do better. **That’s why I’m running to be the next Republican U.S. Senator from New Mexico,[and why I’m asking for your support.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e76d11f13dab45a383f167eaf298750d&_e=E3Dnws1qd2um8dgVrN8qF7wNpGSUwwXGtqWhV1h414hsVKjB71lWd1B0G0RUztEvJvTRQRkjiUf4xhhQjjccQmYJ3iasYMI6vx7nJyYNm7GSvlejttwN_BTg2vUmqwgii2T4MRz7E7jxX-y9Kvn7xOfEg5kwTiQOZtciz90oUs5nWy3LA7bOgUFghbaid3Eb812fv2E2TovnLYqPmt8fSQ_pCjvpqla-ZKTOL3MQLw0_PHZmuFuWRT6lfYQqDLsnrAQ5af8DpL2Eu8qN4wxgtDUVzKCOBLKgP1kHPkLg6v5KKLdW_KFgJ3EpkN_99ObJ3aiIy_Fbak0U_Yzsz-G5-NlJwhLZeWe7_vvN0GSFBMmpA96yEnDrj5il-XT4a7rJfXgYkIBfOEcUl1P4drDhJw%3D%3D)**

[ ** JOIN NELLA » **](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e76d11f13dab45a383f167eaf298750d&_e=E3Dnws1qd2um8dgVrN8qF7wNpGSUwwXGtqWhV1h414hsVKjB71lWd1B0G0RUztEvJvTRQRkjiUf4xhhQjjccQmYJ3iasYMI6vx7nJyYNm7GSvlejttwN_BTg2vUmqwgii2T4MRz7E7jxX-y9Kvn7xOfEg5kwTiQOZtciz90oUs5nWy3LA7bOgUFghbaid3Eb812fv2E2TovnLYqPmt8fSQ_pCjvpqla-ZKTOL3MQLw0_PHZmuFuWRT6lfYQqDLsnN-bkn4ePcWgBNv0za3il-OG8xAOOdjLJz-uOLfa0TMn4nslImrgyV7ntk3xpLo2BQoyNzsQOa1GbMaaCvutDaeT6cSgzC4H9Zz8bJCWi9KYZbuoLtHckE7LWi94FBSJohKkDc5FdRRw469IQ7SD7ow%3D%3D)
These are SOME of New Mexico’s issues that are national issues that I will fight for when I reach the Senate:

* **Securing the border** , stopping the flow of fentanyl and human trafficking
* **Lowering costs** for hardworking Americans and unleashing American domestic energy
* **Making neighborhoods safe** for our families and supporting the police
* **Improving education** through choice and competition
* Destigmatizing and finally **addressing mental illness**

But to get these things done, we need a Republican-controlled Senate so we have a majority that actually cares about these things.

**Flipping New Mexico will put the majority back in Republican hands, and that’s why your support in this race is so critical.**

We’ve taken the Democrats by surprise and have put this race on the map in 2024. As the official Republican nominee, [**I now need your help to continue gaining momentum and build a winning campaign.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e76d11f13dab45a383f167eaf298750d&_e=E3Dnws1qd2um8dgVrN8qF7wNpGSUwwXGtqWhV1h414hsVKjB71lWd1B0G0RUztEvJvTRQRkjiUf4xhhQjjccQmYJ3iasYMI6vx7nJyYNm7GSvlejttwN_BTg2vUmqwgii2T4MRz7E7jxX-y9Kvn7xOfEg5kwTiQOZtciz90oUs5nWy3LA7bOgUFghbaid3Eb812fv2E2TovnLYqPmt8fSQ_pCjvpqla-ZKTOL3MQLw0_PHZmuFuWRT6lfYQqDLsn6pPJ24DFOY2aayluJ8bEmneSGl_yd6gKc3X79ZvUxikX__Ezqv0rQKv_fclwxR529NEcKSK3iruYrb2-JNj9DthMH-Jj2XSt2KPv0xXHORJNZ7HfZuqaV6zUE26G9VlclS3BnHeb501OguRSoCHZQA%3D%3D)

[**Please chip in $10, $25, $50, or more to help us ditch a Senator who votes with Biden’s failed policies 98% of the time. Let’s restore conservative leadership in this seat and the Senate.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e76d11f13dab45a383f167eaf298750d&_e=E3Dnws1qd2um8dgVrN8qF7wNpGSUwwXGtqWhV1h414hsVKjB71lWd1B0G0RUztEvJvTRQRkjiUf4xhhQjjccQmYJ3iasYMI6vx7nJyYNm7GSvlejttwN_BTg2vUmqwgii2T4MRz7E7jxX-y9Kvn7xOfEg5kwTiQOZtciz90oUs5nWy3LA7bOgUFghbaid3Eb812fv2E2TovnLYqPmt8fSQ_pCjvpqla-ZKTOL3MQLw0_PHZmuFuWRT6lfYQqDLsn-rZj2W_8PrOtKAqTs1EpjbSWoxHPhiPRjK-ZZvsW3GDWYEVnfWepdX0Oq6tgXvOcU1xV8TSgnnW4rday4H0MvEJPcfyAMkYDiy0eLHhLNk3T5C87dcKXz141BKUxzMVfTGkr4tRuDWBGzLj2DRfB9g%3D%3D)

Thank you,

**Nella Domenici**
Candidate for U.S. Senate, New Mexico

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:
Friend , is there anything I can say to convince you to split $20 between my campaign and Serve America [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-sherrod] before my midnight deadline?
Would it make any difference if I shared that, with Senate control hinging on my race in Ohio, we're officially losing ground in the latest polls?
What if I told you my GOP opponent is a self-funding millionaire ready to do whatever it takes to buy this seat and flip the Senate red – and he just raised nearly $350,000 at a massive Mar-a-Lago fundraiser?
And what if I told you that Mitch McConnell-aligned super PACs just made their largest ad reservation in one state ever to turn the tides against me?
I know that's a lot of alarming information to throw at you, but here's the good news: With enough grassroots support from folks like you, I know we can reach tonight's critical goal, surge ahead, and protect this seat.
So, what do you say, friend ? Will you split just $20 now between my campaign and Serve America to power our grassroots movement forward so we can win in Ohio and keep the Senate blue? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-sherrod]
Thanks so much for being a part of my team,
Sherrod Brown

body:
From the cost of living to protecting our fundamental freedoms and safeguarding our democracy, there are countless issues that demand our attention and action.
Friend,

This November, so much is at stake. From lowering the cost of living to protecting our fundamental freedoms and safeguarding our democracy, there are countless issues that demand our attention and action.

That's why I'm reaching out to you today. I’m ready to flip NY-17 so I can return to Congress and once again deliver results for the hardworking people of the Lower Hudson Valley. [](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=caught_in_action_4_11_24_nd1&n=2)

Dear Peter,
In a desperate move, the DNC resorted to paying protesters to disrupt our recent campaign event, a tactic as transparent as it is underhanded.
Our Campaign Director, Amaryllis Fox, revealed that these individuals, some of them homeless, were offered money to stage opposition — _a low blow reflecting the DNC's fear of our growing momentum_.
Please notice that all of the signs are written in identical handwriting:
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=caught_in_action_4_11_24_nd1&n=3)

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: It’s all the fight
body:
Friends,

The fight for democracy is the fight for freedom is the fight for choice. It is all the same fight and it’s a fight we must - and will - win.

This week’s ruling out of Arizona is a terrifying reminder of the stakes of this fight. With one court opinion, a handful of justices - who were appointed years ago by a former Republican Governor - robbed over 3.5 million women of their reproductive rights and freedoms. Arizona women are now under the onus of a restrictive abortion ban that was passed 60 years before women could even vote.

In 2022 thousands of Michiganders came together and made it possible for us to enshrine reproductive freedom in our state constitution. It was a crucial step in the fight and it showed the power we have when we vote in favor of our rights and our democracy.

But it’s clear that the fight is not yet over.

Arizona’s court ruling shows there is a coordinated effort unfolding state by state to roll back our rights and freedoms. But it doesn’t stop there - even as partisan gerrymandering and judicial appointments have stacked the deck in their favor and more unfair and unjust decisions will come down. If they can pass a national ban, they will.

And let me be perfectly clear: this isn't just about abortion rights. Look at what happened in Alabama with IVF. A majority of House Republicans have signed on to ban almost all forms of contraception.
Those are the stakes of our elections this year. We face a choice between defending our rights and allowing far-right extremists to take them away. You see the power of state Supreme Courts on this issue – which is why our work supporting a pro-democracy, pro-choice Michigan Supreme Court matters so much.

I’ll say it again: The fight for democracy is the fight for freedom is the fight for choice. It is all the same fight.

We’ve fought hard to protect and expand our rights in Michigan. But that fight is not over. It’s why I’m redoubling my efforts to support pro-democracy leaders, and why I built the Michigan Legacy PAC to help every citizen see their role in this fight.

If you’re with me, please pitch in today and let’s make sure we protect Michigan’s legacy of democracy and freedom >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michiganlegacypac?refcode=emq224]

I’m honored to have you with me in this fight.

-Jocelyn

America is clearly on the wrong track – over two-thirds of Americans agree, _and you’re likely one of them._

Less than 40% approve of the job Joe Biden is doing, and there’s no arguing that he and Martin Heinrich have let us down.

But it’s more than that – together, they’ve pushed policies that are actively harming Americans; from our families, to our jobs, to our safety, to our freedoms.

These are SOME of New Mexico’s issues that are national issues that I will fight for when I reach the Senate:

* **Securing the border** , stopping the flow of fentanyl and human trafficking
* **Lowering costs** for hardworking Americans and unleashing American domestic energy

* Destigmatizing and finally **addressing mental illness**

But to get these things done, we need a Republican-controlled Senate so we have a majority that actually cares about these things.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Every member of the Squad is up for re-election this year, and five of
these young, working-class, Black and brown progressives are facing
serious threats to their U.S. House seats: Jamaal Bowman, Cori Bush,
Summer Lee, Ilhan Omar, and Rashida Tlaib.

Justice Democrats is working alongside 10+ organizations to raise the
alarm and bring our progressive movement together to Protect the Squad
from being ousted in 2024.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email.UHRoyb&refcode=em20240411-34263&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=34263%2E1203867%2ESSoyEl ]We’re working to raise $100,000 for the five most vulnerable Squad
members before April ends. Can you chip in now to directly support Jamaal,
Cori, Summer, Ilhan, and Rashida today?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email.UHRoyb&refcode=em20240411-34263&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=34263%2E1203867%2ESSoyEl ]Protect the Squad:

The Squad is made up of THE most progressive members of Congress fighting
for the bold change our communities, country, and world deserve. Since
they were first elected, these representatives have gone to bat for
Medicare for All, the Green New Deal, a permanent ceasefire in Gaza,
student debt forgiveness, a livable minimum wage, criminal justice reform,
affordable housing, and so much more.

But their progressive positions have made them the top targets of
corporate special interests, right-wing millionaires and billionaires, and
the Democratic establishment who are threatened by their fight to change
the status quo.

GOP megadonor-funded groups like AIPAC and Moderate PAC are threatening to
drop $100 million on attack ads and hand-picked challengers to unseat
these Squad members in the primary and general elections this year.

There has never been a time when our movement has been more under threat.
But this level of spending is happening because our strategy is working:
our progressive movement has real power in Congress that wasn’t built by
corporate dollars or compromising our communities, it was built by all of
YOU.

This is why — despite the millions of dollars coming down the pike — we
don’t just believe, we KNOW we can win. The AIPAC network would not be
spending what they are if they didn’t think so too.

Our secret weapon is what it has always come down to: organized people
power. Our candidates have beaten corporate and right-wing super PAC money
in the past, and they can do it again with this movement’s help.

That’s why we need to come together ASAP to combat AIPAC’s funneling of
right-wing money into democratic primaries with the power of our
grassroots movement and build the resources needed to stop them from
ousting a single member of the Squad in 2024.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email.UHRoyb&refcode=em20240411-34263&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=34263%2E1203867%2ESSoyEl ]Show Jamaal, Cori, Summer, Ilhan, and Rashida that you have their backs
in this critical election year. Rush a donation now to help protect and
re-elect the Squad!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email.UHRoyb&refcode=em20240411-34263&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=34263%2E1203867%2ESSoyEl ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

name: Rashida Tlaib
subject: Supporting Arab American candidates this Arab American Heritage Month
body:
Elected officials saving lives. | | |
---
Friend, For the first time, the United States recognized April as Arab American Heritage Month last year. **As a proud Arab American woman serving in Congress, I know how important it is that our community feels seen, heard, and celebrated by our government.** Unfortunately, this month also marks 6 months of genocide against the Palestinian people, with more than 33,000 killed from U.S.-made bombs and ammunition, and 2 million more forcibly displaced and forcibly starved by the Israeli military. **That’s why we need more courageous voices that are unapologetically committed to saving lives, no matter faith or ethnicity, by demanding a permanent ceasefire.** In Michigan, I’m proud to endorse a number of candidates with diverse backgrounds, and this month in celebration of Arab American Heritage Month, I want to highlight three Arab American candidates for State Representative―each of whom is leading demands for a ceasefire and uplifting the voices of marginalized communities. Because these three candidates have had the courage to speak out for the humanity of the Palestinian people, each is vulnerable to attacks by those who seek to silence us―including by anti-Palestinian group AIPAC, which has pledged to spend $100 million in an attempt to defeat pro-ceasefire candidates running for all levels of office. [**Help elect these three progressive Arab American candidates by splitting a donation between each today, as well as donating to my Rooted In Community Leadership PAC, which is investing in our communities and working to elect anti-war candidates at all levels of government.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsXu0R1XDWRVJnEMC9_ePsJvdjPydL8iYHorKbjm0GAs5X7957xTucNe0DHeEdtYpRkSJNM_LsGwXNxe03RsaJ6FeKiJUyZDNU8lYTeGgoZ0W3Pb1EJD2LtfLgyk0q2RIGz-wdKfg7U11Bpg2cPDwvb00azzHD-quFtllAXJpYimwOU14aWTGtmZY8XJ9IsCSjo0t9gqPPES1tq45NzSynsz2hYdtNZrlt5WTKapGXreL014S_7ZiUQZ_J_xbc4tgwDZVtnzZK5D4Qjkla3rxfUkqn2LeJ6wWcr-5oZ_ukPe12eHGitaXLEZB6AfQqijeQXFM9vZCKbZZr17RwsEUlmMvqlHK0fdjZ8XUjLnjKF5tyGouyREcZwsX7MUDAL6gkdlN_ZCYMQ3tZ4uoq-4NAu-IZKAn_xk7zaEMLfdbadUD7Wd8dXS_IixuIVPFnzQYy4DMl_SDx-CNdqAEZ4lNH2/45f/lYRUvDqYTsW2ktJwhd2xZg/h0/h001.CzFGba_3YPOyZfRPZ_BZVJ2ajWQgxb7-OqzS1AvbaOg) | [SPLIT A DONATION](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsXu0R1XDWRVJnEMC9_ePsJvdjPydL8iYHorKbjm0GAs5X7957xTucNe0DHeEdtYpRkSJNM_LsGwXNxe03RsaJ6Sb0zJ6_CYYHFAwo7nKBsds0pYN2GxRyeVvViyPGf648GYhUjVuRJAEZcsQEDOf5RHutY6p74FvAADLFeP-42xD_CuhPLA5GXc2A-xjp9SOB1DSWoQVG2oPap3u7MF6opkT8vo4CbFcncX6nw7a3cK4tqv8sHpg3as_J9lKUpBFm6pfBGKGoyU7Jo8_q1lMOeO5zWXeu7F24AG-iv_ByBECXgC5dWihH6OhlofgcaKJNOOofAHhlRqxx7eVpLfzxDubURXqRlxgpbCEPWnkvrmil6a6QMX4y8JUQVUtuVjRsL7-utgR8cYRW7snd2Q1jO5SXe1C8-1V3Y--WQJ8FP6GLxXmHQGmaHIb_llBzY4gY5L-YVxTojY9LdDXq8GRN0/45f/lYRUvDqYTsW2ktJwhd2xZg/h1/h001.A-ELansLU-SrL2cza329fBAiKUrE2Vt-GY6ZOqFq6uQ)

We've made important strides in demanding representation and ending the systemic erasure of our communities. I've pushed for years to include Arab and Middle Eastern and North African communities in the U.S. Census―instead of requiring us to identify as “white” or “other”―and this year the federal government finally took action to do so.
**Still, American Muslims and Arab Americans do not feel represented by our government right now.**
Words and platitudes are not enough, especially at a time when leaders in the United States government dehumanize us and continue to send billions of dollars of weapons to kill innocent civilians in Gaza.

clean_body: Elected officials saving lives. | | | Friend, For the first time, the United States recognized April as Arab American Heritage Month last year. As a proud Arab American woman serving in Congress, I know how important it is that our community feels seen, heard, and celebrated by our government. Unfortunately, this month also marks 6 months of genocide against the Palestinian people, with more than 33,000 killed from U.S.-made bombs and ammunition, and 2 million more forcibly displaced and forcibly starved by the Israeli military. That’s why we need more courageous voices that are unapologetically committed to saving lives, no matter faith or ethnicity, by demanding a permanent ceasefire. In Michigan, I’m proud to endorse a number of candidates with diverse backgrounds, and this month in celebration of Arab American Heritage Month, I want to highlight three Arab American candidates for State Representative―each of whom is leading demands for a ceasefire and uplifting the voices of marginalized communities. Because these three candidates have had the courage to speak out for the humanity of the Palestinian people, each is vulnerable to attacks by those who seek to silence us―including by anti-Palestinian group AIPAC, which has pledged to spend $100 million in an attempt to defeat pro-ceasefire candidates running for all levels of office. | We've made important strides in demanding representation and ending the systemic erasure of our communities. I've pushed for years to include Arab and Middle Eastern and North African communities in the U.S. Census―instead of requiring us to identify as “white” or “other”―and this year the federal government finally took action to do so. Still, American Muslims and Arab Americans do not feel represented by our government right now. Words and platitudes are not enough, especially at a time when leaders in the United States government dehumanize us and continue to send billions of dollars of weapons to kill innocent civilians in Gaza. body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=2661%2E552475%2E7DKBb_)
Hi Peter, I’ll admit I’m excited about this.
When my team told me our new Pennsylvania map at campaign HQ was pretty big, they weren’t kidding — just look at this thing!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240411-3?refcode=em20240411-3&refcode2=2661_552475_7DKBb_&akid=2661%2E552475%2E7DKBb_)
We’re covering this map with the names of supporters from all across the Commonwealth — and getting your name on the map could not be more important to us.
[**If you donate any amount right now, you’ll stake your spot on our map.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240411-3?refcode=em20240411-3&refcode2=2661_552475_7DKBb_&akid=2661%2E552475%2E7DKBb_)
**[Get on the Map ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240411-3?refcode=em20240411-3&refcode2=2661_552475_7DKBb_&akid=2661%2E552475%2E7DKBb_)**
What happens here in Pennsylvania will determine the fate of our entire Nation. If we lose this race, Democrats could lose both the Senate and the White House – impacting everything from women’s rights to the promise of Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security.
If we’re going to win this thing, it’s going to take an army of supporters like you, Peter, chipping in when you can.
That’s why we’re going to continue covering our map of Pennsylvania from top to bottom with the names of folks on this team. I need you by my side to stand up to the money my mega-millionaire opponent and the GOP super PACs that back him are already spending to flip this seat.
**[Every name on this map represents another person who’s with us in this fight. Will you reserve your spot on the map by making a donation today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240411-3?refcode=em20240411-3&refcode2=2661_552475_7DKBb_&akid=2661%2E552475%2E7DKBb_)**
**[Get on the Map ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240411-3?refcode=em20240411-3&refcode2=2661_552475_7DKBb_&akid=2661%2E552475%2E7DKBb_)**
I’m glad to have your support. We’re hoping to fill this map up quickly — so get your name on while you can.
With gratitude,
Bob

Dear friend,
Greetings, I’m Christopher Kowerdovich, and I have the honor of serving as the Chair of the Pennsylvania Democratic Veterans Caucus. I’m reaching out with exciting news: we’ve officially endorsed Rep. Malcolm Kenyatta for Auditor General, and I’d like to tell you why.
Why We Stand with Malcolm Kenyatta We support Malcolm Kenyatta's campaign for his dedication to veterans and working families in Pennsylvania. Let me get personal with you for a moment. As someone who served as a queer veteran during the “don’t ask, don’t tell” era, seeing Malcolm shattering another glass ceiling in Pennsylvania feels like a surreal dream come true.
Advocating for Veterans and Their Families
Malcolm has consistently worked to enhance healthcare, education, and job opportunities, not just for veterans, but for their families as well. His support for important national policies, like the Major Richard Star Act, shows his dedication to the financial wellbeing of disabled veterans and their families. It’s clear he understands the economic challenges facing the veterans community.
Inclusive Economic Leadership
Malcolm embodies leadership through inclusivity, integrity, and innovation. He aims to serve every Pennsylvanian, pushing for economic development that uplifts everyone. His vision for a prosperous state for all working families, including veterans and their families, is something we strongly support.
How You Can Help:
Y our support is crucial in electing Malcolm Kenyatta as Auditor General, a leader who values veterans and working for a prosperous future for all.

All the best,
Christopher Kowerdovich

body:
Earlier this week, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born. | Folks, I am incredibly disappointed. Earlier this week, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born. They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War. **No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest. ** As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass. It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance. It was a dark day, but this is **NOT** over. If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster if that’s what it takes. I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign. Hi, it’s Alex.
I’ll get right to it -- [**I’m asking you to split a $5 contribution between my campaign and Tammy Baldwin in Wisconsin.](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-apr24-baldwin.kJekhB&refcode=em240411-1-t2&t=1&akid=1690%2E159979%2ERaaenY)**
I believe that our democracy works best when everyone gets involved. As California’s Secretary of State, I worked to make it easier for people to securely cast their vote and expanded access to the ballot.
So it’s particularly galling to me to see people like Tammy’s opponent (and a fellow Californian!) Eric Hovde say that most nursing home residents are “not at a point to vote” repeating debunked claims about voter fraud in nursing homes in 2020. And it didn’t stop there — he outright attacked members of the Greatest Generation to make his point!
This isn’t a longshot candidate either. He’s been endorsed by Donald Trump, and Mitch McConnell and National Republicans are going to spend millions propping him up and attacking Tammy Baldwin.
These are the stakes in 2024. We’ve got to organize nationwide to defend our Senate majority and keep election-deniers like Eric Hovde and Donald Trump out of office.
